@staticmethod
def library_index_from_node_id(node_id: str) -> int | None: 
396    @staticmethod
397    def library_index_from_node_id(node_id: str) -> int | None:
398        """Parse a library matrix index from an internal node ID, if any.
399
400        Accepts the canonical ``lib:<idx>`` form. Bare integer strings are
401        also accepted for backward compatibility with older matrices.
402        """
403        if node_id is None:
404            return None
405        s = str(node_id)
406        if s.startswith(_LIB_NODE_PREFIX):
407            try:
408                return int(s[len(_LIB_NODE_PREFIX) :])
409            except ValueError:
410                return None
411        try:
412            return int(s)
413        except (TypeError, ValueError):
414            return None

Parse a library matrix index from an internal node ID, if any.

Accepts the canonical lib:<idx> form. Bare integer strings are also accepted for backward compatibility with older matrices.

def run_query_vs_query_only( self, query_spectra: list, query_ids: list[str], query_precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None, fe_kwargs: dict | None = None) -> None: 
702    def run_query_vs_query_only(
703        self,
704        query_spectra: list,
705        query_ids: list[str],
706        query_precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None,
707        fe_kwargs: dict | None = None,
708    ) -> None:
709        """Compute query-vs-query similarities (stage 1 only).
710
711        Builds a temporary FlashEntropy index from *query_spectra* and
712        computes all-vs-all pairwise similarities within that set.  Results
713        are stored in :attr:`similarity_matrices`.
714
715        After this call, :attr:`stage_query_query_done` is ``True``.  If a
716        reference library was provided at construction time you may continue
717        with :meth:`run_query_vs_library_stage`.
718
719        Parameters
720        ----------
721        query_spectra : list
722            Spectrum objects with ``.mz_exp`` and ``.abundance`` attributes.
723        query_ids : list of str
724            Unique string ID for each spectrum.
725        query_precursor_mzs : list of float or None, optional
726            Precursor m/z for each spectrum.  Required (non-None list) for
727            ``"identity"`` and ``"neutral_loss"`` search types.
728        fe_kwargs : dict, optional
729            Extra keyword arguments forwarded to
730            :class:`ms_entropy.FlashEntropySearch` when building the
731            temporary query index.
732
733        Raises
734        ------
735        RuntimeError
736            If queries have already been run (call :meth:`drop_queries` first).
737        ValueError
738            If *query_spectra* is empty, lengths are mismatched, or precursor
739            m/z values are missing for a precursor-required search type.
740        """
741        if self._has_queries_run:
742            raise RuntimeError(
743                "query_vs_library has already been run — call drop_queries() to clear queries and results before running again."
744            )
745
746        self._prepare_queries(
747            query_spectra=query_spectra,
748            query_ids=query_ids,
749            query_precursor_mzs=query_precursor_mzs,
750        )
751        self._run_query_vs_query(fe_kwargs=fe_kwargs)
752        self._has_queries_run = True

Compute query-vs-query similarities (stage 1 only).

Builds a temporary FlashEntropy index from query_spectra and computes all-vs-all pairwise similarities within that set. Results are stored in similarity_matrices.

After this call, stage_query_query_done is True. If a reference library was provided at construction time you may continue with run_query_vs_library_stage().

Parameters
  • query_spectra (list): Spectrum objects with .mz_exp and .abundance attributes.
  • query_ids (list of str): Unique string ID for each spectrum.
  • query_precursor_mzs (list of float or None, optional): Precursor m/z for each spectrum. Required (non-None list) for "identity" and "neutral_loss" search types.
  • fe_kwargs (dict, optional): Extra keyword arguments forwarded to ms_entropy.FlashEntropySearch when building the temporary query index.
Raises
  • RuntimeError: If queries have already been run (call drop_queries() first).
  • ValueError: If query_spectra is empty, lengths are mismatched, or precursor m/z values are missing for a precursor-required search type.
def run_query_vs_library_stage(self) -> None: 
754    def run_query_vs_library_stage(self) -> None:
755        """Continue from stage 1 and compute query-vs-library similarities (stage 2).
756
757        Searches each stored query spectrum against the reference FE library
758        and stores entropy + cosine scores in :attr:`similarity_matrices`.
759        After this call, :attr:`stage_query_library_done` is ``True``.
760
761        Stage-3 library subset selection uses
762        *library_similarity_threshold* on :meth:`run_library_vs_library_stage`
763        (or the same keyword on :meth:`query_vs_library`), not this method.
764
765        Raises
766        ------
767        RuntimeError
768            If stage 1 has not been completed (call
769            :meth:`run_query_vs_query_only` first) or if ``fe_lib`` is
770            ``None``.
771        """
772        if not self._has_queries_run:
773            raise RuntimeError(
774                "No queries have been run yet — call run_query_vs_query_only() or query_vs_library() first."
775            )
776
777        entropy_pairs, _ = self._run_query_vs_library()
778        self._stage2_entropy_pairs = entropy_pairs

Continue from stage 1 and compute query-vs-library similarities (stage 2).

Searches each stored query spectrum against the reference FE library and stores entropy + cosine scores in similarity_matrices. After this call, stage_query_library_done is True.

Stage-3 library subset selection uses library_similarity_threshold on run_library_vs_library_stage() (or the same keyword on query_vs_library()), not this method.

Raises
  • RuntimeError: If stage 1 has not been completed (call run_query_vs_query_only() first) or if fe_lib is None.
def run_library_vs_library_stage(self, library_similarity_threshold: float = 0.3) -> None: 
780    def run_library_vs_library_stage(
781        self,
782        library_similarity_threshold: float = 0.3,
783    ) -> None:
784        """Continue from stage 2 and compute library-vs-library similarities (stage 3).
785
786        Identifies library spectra that scored ≥ *library_similarity_threshold*
787        against any query in stage 2, then computes all-vs-all pairwise
788        similarities within that subset.  Results are stored in
789        :attr:`similarity_matrices` and :attr:`stage_library_library_done`
790        is set to ``True``.
791
792        Parameters
793        ----------
794        library_similarity_threshold : float, optional
795            Minimum entropy similarity score (from stage 2) required for a
796            library spectrum to be included in this stage.  Default 0.3.
797
798        Raises
799        ------
800        RuntimeError
801            If stage 2 has not been completed (call
802            :meth:`run_query_vs_library_stage` first).
803        """
804        if self._stage2_entropy_pairs is None:
805            raise RuntimeError(
806                "query-vs-library stage must be run before library-vs-library stage."
807            )
808
809        self._run_library_vs_library(
810            entropy_pairs=self._stage2_entropy_pairs,
811            library_similarity_threshold=library_similarity_threshold,
812        )

Continue from stage 2 and compute library-vs-library similarities (stage 3).

Identifies library spectra that scored ≥ library_similarity_threshold against any query in stage 2, then computes all-vs-all pairwise similarities within that subset. Results are stored in similarity_matrices and stage_library_library_done is set to True.

Parameters
  • library_similarity_threshold (float, optional): Minimum entropy similarity score (from stage 2) required for a library spectrum to be included in this stage. Default 0.3.
Raises
  • RuntimeError: If stage 2 has not been completed (call run_query_vs_library_stage() first).
def query_vs_library( self, query_spectra: list, query_ids: list[str], query_precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None, fe_kwargs: dict | None = None, *, hydrate_library_similarities: bool | None = None, library_similarity_threshold: float | None = None) -> None: 
814    def query_vs_library(
815        self,
816        query_spectra: list,
817        query_ids: list[str],
818        query_precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None,
819        fe_kwargs: dict | None = None,
820        *,
821        hydrate_library_similarities: bool | None = None,
822        library_similarity_threshold: float | None = None,
823    ) -> None:
824        """Run all three stages in one call (convenience wrapper).
825
826        Executes stages 1–3 sequentially:
827
828        1. **Query-vs-query** – builds a temporary FlashEntropy index from
829           *query_spectra* and computes all-vs-all pairwise similarities.
830        2. **Query-vs-library** – searches each query against the reference
831           FE library (``self.fe_lib``).
832        3. **Library-vs-library** *(optional)* – when
833           *hydrate_library_similarities* is ``True``, computes pairwise
834           similarities for the subset of library spectra that matched any
835           query above *library_similarity_threshold*.
836
837        All results are stored in :attr:`similarity_matrices`.
838
839        Parameters
840        ----------
841        query_spectra : list
842            Spectrum objects with ``.mz_exp`` and ``.abundance`` attributes.
843        query_ids : list of str
844            Unique string ID for each spectrum.
845        query_precursor_mzs : list of float or None, optional
846            Precursor m/z for each spectrum.  Required (non-None list) for
847            ``"identity"`` and ``"neutral_loss"`` search types.
848        fe_kwargs : dict, optional
849            Extra keyword arguments forwarded to
850            :class:`ms_entropy.FlashEntropySearch` when building the
851            temporary query index (stage 1). When None and *settings* was
852            provided at construction, uses ``settings.as_fe_kwargs()``.
853        hydrate_library_similarities : bool, optional
854            When ``True``, run stage 3 (library-vs-library). Default from
855            *settings* or ``False``.
856        library_similarity_threshold : float, optional
857            Minimum entropy similarity score (stage 2) required for a library
858            spectrum to be included in stage 3. Default from *settings* or 0.3.
859
860        Raises
861        ------
862        RuntimeError
863            If queries have already been run (call :meth:`drop_queries` first)
864            or if ``fe_lib`` is ``None`` (required for stages 2 and 3).
865        ValueError
866            If *query_spectra* is empty, lengths are mismatched, or precursor
867            m/z values are missing for a precursor-required search type.
868        """
869        if self._has_queries_run:
870            raise RuntimeError(
871                "query_vs_library has already been run — call drop_queries() to clear queries and results before running again."
872            )
873
874        if hydrate_library_similarities is None:
875            hydrate_library_similarities = (
876                self._settings.hydrate_library_similarities
877                if self._settings is not None
878                else False
879            )
880        if library_similarity_threshold is None:
881            library_similarity_threshold = (
882                self._settings.library_similarity_threshold
883                if self._settings is not None
884                else 0.3
885            )
886
887        self._prepare_queries(
888            query_spectra=query_spectra,
889            query_ids=query_ids,
890            query_precursor_mzs=query_precursor_mzs,
891        )
892        self._run_query_vs_query(fe_kwargs=fe_kwargs)
893        entropy_pairs, _ = self._run_query_vs_library()
894
895        if hydrate_library_similarities:
896            self._run_library_vs_library(
897                entropy_pairs=entropy_pairs,
898                library_similarity_threshold=library_similarity_threshold,
899            )
900
901        self._has_queries_run = True

Run all three stages in one call (convenience wrapper).

Executes stages 1–3 sequentially:

  1. Query-vs-query – builds a temporary FlashEntropy index from query_spectra and computes all-vs-all pairwise similarities.
  2. Query-vs-library – searches each query against the reference FE library (self.fe_lib).
  3. Library-vs-library (optional) – when hydrate_library_similarities is True, computes pairwise similarities for the subset of library spectra that matched any query above library_similarity_threshold.

All results are stored in similarity_matrices.

Parameters
  • query_spectra (list): Spectrum objects with .mz_exp and .abundance attributes.
  • query_ids (list of str): Unique string ID for each spectrum.
  • query_precursor_mzs (list of float or None, optional): Precursor m/z for each spectrum. Required (non-None list) for "identity" and "neutral_loss" search types.
  • fe_kwargs (dict, optional): Extra keyword arguments forwarded to ms_entropy.FlashEntropySearch when building the temporary query index (stage 1). When None and settings was provided at construction, uses settings.as_fe_kwargs().
  • hydrate_library_similarities (bool, optional): When True, run stage 3 (library-vs-library). Default from settings or False.
  • library_similarity_threshold (float, optional): Minimum entropy similarity score (stage 2) required for a library spectrum to be included in stage 3. Default from settings or 0.3.
Raises
  • RuntimeError: If queries have already been run (call drop_queries() first) or if fe_lib is None (required for stages 2 and 3).
  • ValueError: If query_spectra is empty, lengths are mismatched, or precursor m/z values are missing for a precursor-required search type.

def get_spectrum_neighbors( self, spectrum_id: str, metric: str = 'entropy_similarity') -> list[tuple[str, float]]: 
922    def get_spectrum_neighbors(
923        self,
924        spectrum_id: str,
925        metric: str = "entropy_similarity",
926    ) -> list[tuple[str, float]]:
927        """Return all neighbors of *spectrum_id* above the threshold.
928
929        Parameters
930        ----------
931        spectrum_id : str
932            Query spectrum ID.
933        metric : str
934            Similarity metric to query.  Default ``"entropy_similarity"``.
935
936        Returns
937        -------
938        list of (neighbor_id, score)
939            Sorted by score descending.
940        """
941        mat = self._get_matrix(metric)
942        threshold = self._threshold_for(metric)
943
944        if spectrum_id not in mat._id_to_idx:
945            return []
946
947        idx = mat._id_to_idx[spectrum_id]
948        if mat._matrix is None:
949            return []
950
951        mat.finalise()
952        row = mat._matrix.getrow(idx)
953        cx = row.tocoo()
954        neighbors = []
955        for j, v in zip(cx.col, cx.data):
956            if v >= threshold and j != idx:
957                neighbors.append((mat._idx_to_id[j], float(v)))
958        neighbors.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
959        return neighbors

def get_network_stats(self, metric: str = 'entropy_similarity') -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
961    def get_network_stats(self, metric: str = "entropy_similarity") -> dict[str, Any]:
962        """Return basic network statistics for *metric*.
963
964        Parameters
965        ----------
966        metric : str
967            Similarity metric to query.  Default ``"entropy_similarity"``.
968
969        Returns
970        -------
971        dict with keys:
972            - ``n_nodes`` : number of registered spectra
973            - ``n_edges`` : number of edges above threshold
974            - ``avg_degree`` : average node degree
975            - ``density`` : fraction of possible edges that exist
976            - ``threshold`` : the threshold used
977            - ``metric`` : the metric name
978        """
979        mat = self._get_matrix(metric)
980        threshold = self._threshold_for(metric)
981        edges = mat.get_pairs_above_threshold(threshold)
982        n_nodes = mat.n_spectra
983        n_edges = len(edges)
984        max_edges = n_nodes * (n_nodes - 1) / 2 if n_nodes > 1 else 1
985        degrees = {sid: 0 for sid in mat.spectrum_ids}
986        for id1, id2, _ in edges:
987            degrees[id1] += 1
988            degrees[id2] += 1
989        avg_degree = np.mean(list(degrees.values())) if degrees else 0.0
990        return {
991            "metric": metric,
992            "threshold": threshold,
993            "n_nodes": n_nodes,
994            "n_edges": n_edges,
995            "avg_degree": float(avg_degree),
996            "density": n_edges / max_edges if max_edges > 0 else 0.0,
997        }

def drop_queries(self): 
1059    def drop_queries(self):
1060        """Clear all stored queries and computed similarity results.
1061
1062        Resets internal query storage, stage flags, the stage-2 entropy-pair
1063        cache, clustering artifacts, and reinitialises all
1064        :attr:`similarity_matrices` to empty so that
1065        :meth:`run_query_vs_query_only` or :meth:`query_vs_library` can be
1066        called again with a consistent cleared state.
1067        """
1068        # Clear stored queries
1069        self._all_query_spectra = []
1070        self._all_query_ids = []
1071        self._all_query_precursor_mzs = []
1072        self._has_queries_run = False
1073        self._stage2_entropy_pairs = None
1074
1075        # Stage flags must match empty matrices (not "stale done")
1076        self.stage_query_query_done = False
1077        self.stage_query_library_done = False
1078        self.stage_library_library_done = False
1079
1080        # Recreate empty similarity matrices for each metric
1081        all_metrics = list(self.similarity_matrices.keys())
1082        self.similarity_matrices = {
1083            m: SimilarityMatrix(metric_name=m) for m in all_metrics
1084        }
1085
1086        # Drop any cached clustering artifacts tied to previous query results.
1087        self._network_clusters = {}

Clear all stored queries and computed similarity results.

Resets internal query storage, stage flags, the stage-2 entropy-pair cache, clustering artifacts, and reinitialises all similarity_matrices to empty so that run_query_vs_query_only() or query_vs_library() can be called again with a consistent cleared state.

class SimilarityMatrix: 
 21class SimilarityMatrix:
 22    """Sparse, symmetric similarity matrix for one spectral similarity metric.
 23
 24    Parameters
 25    ----------
 26    metric_name : str
 27        Name of the similarity metric stored in this matrix
 28        (e.g., ``"entropy_similarity"``, ``"cosine"``).
 29
 30    Attributes
 31    ----------
 32    metric_name : str
 33        Name of the similarity metric.
 34    _id_to_idx : dict
 35        Mapping from spectrum ID (str) to integer matrix index.
 36    _idx_to_id : list
 37        Mapping from integer matrix index to spectrum ID.
 38    _matrix : scipy.sparse.lil_matrix or None
 39        Underlying sparse matrix (lil for construction, csr after finalise).
 40    _is_csr : bool
 41        True when the matrix has been converted to CSR format.
 42    """
 43
 44    def __init__(self, metric_name: str = "entropy_similarity"):
 45        self.metric_name = metric_name
 46        self._id_to_idx: dict[str, int] = {}
 47        self._idx_to_id: list[str] = []
 48        self._matrix: lil_matrix | csr_matrix | None = None
 49        self._is_csr: bool = False
 50
 51    # ── Internal helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 52
 53    def _ensure_lil(self):
 54        """Convert to LIL format if currently CSR (needed before adding entries)."""
 55        if self._is_csr and self._matrix is not None:
 56            self._matrix = self._matrix.tolil()
 57            self._is_csr = False
 58
 59    def _grow_matrix(self, new_size: int):
 60        """Grow the sparse matrix to accommodate *new_size* spectra.
 61
 62        Uses 1.5x growth factor to reduce reallocation frequency.
 63        """
 64        if self._matrix is None:
 65            # Pre-allocate with growth factor on first allocation
 66            alloc_size = max(new_size, int(new_size * 1.5))
 67            self._matrix = lil_matrix((alloc_size, alloc_size), dtype=np.float32)
 68            self._is_csr = False
 69        else:
 70            self._ensure_lil()
 71            old_size = self._matrix.shape[0]
 72            if new_size > old_size:
 73                # Grow with 1.5x factor to reduce future reallocations
 74                alloc_size = max(new_size, int(old_size * 1.5))
 75                new_mat = lil_matrix((alloc_size, alloc_size), dtype=np.float32)
 76                cx = self._matrix.tocsr()
 77                new_mat[:old_size, :old_size] = cx
 78                self._matrix = new_mat
 79
 80    # ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 81
 82    def register_spectra(self, spectrum_ids: list[str]):
 83        """Register new spectrum IDs, growing the matrix as needed.
 84
 85        Parameters
 86        ----------
 87        spectrum_ids : list of str
 88            IDs to register.  Already-registered IDs are silently skipped.
 89        """
 90        new_ids = [sid for sid in spectrum_ids if sid not in self._id_to_idx]
 91        if not new_ids:
 92            return
 93        for sid in new_ids:
 94            self._id_to_idx[sid] = len(self._idx_to_id)
 95            self._idx_to_id.append(sid)
 96        self._grow_matrix(len(self._idx_to_id))
 97
 98    def set_similarity(self, id1: str, id2: str, score: float):
 99        """Store a similarity score for a pair of spectra.
100
101        The matrix is symmetric: both (i, j) and (j, i) are set.
102
103        Parameters
104        ----------
105        id1, id2 : str
106            Spectrum IDs (must already be registered).
107        score : float
108            Similarity score to store.
109
110        Raises
111        ------
112        KeyError
113            If either ID has not been registered.
114        """
115        i = self._id_to_idx[id1]
116        j = self._id_to_idx[id2]
117        self._ensure_lil()
118        self._matrix[i, j] = score
119        self._matrix[j, i] = score
120
121    def get_similarity(self, id1: str, id2: str) -> float:
122        """Retrieve the similarity score for a pair of spectra.
123
124        Parameters
125        ----------
126        id1, id2 : str
127            Spectrum IDs.
128
129        Returns
130        -------
131        float
132            Similarity score, or 0.0 if the pair was never stored.
133        """
134        if id1 not in self._id_to_idx or id2 not in self._id_to_idx:
135            return 0.0
136        i = self._id_to_idx[id1]
137        j = self._id_to_idx[id2]
138        if self._matrix is None:
139            return 0.0
140        return float(self._matrix[i, j])
141
142    def finalise(self):
143        """Convert internal LIL matrix to CSR for efficient querying.
144
145        Call this after all ``set_similarity`` calls for a batch are done.
146        Trims matrix to logical size (removes over-allocated space).
147        """
148        if self._matrix is not None and not self._is_csr:
149            logical_size = len(self._idx_to_id)
150            # Trim to logical size if over-allocated
151            if self._matrix.shape[0] > logical_size:
152                self._matrix = self._matrix[:logical_size, :logical_size]
153            self._matrix = self._matrix.tocsr()
154            self._is_csr = True
155
156    def get_pairs_above_threshold(
157        self, threshold: float
158    ) -> list[tuple[str, str, float]]:
159        """Return all stored pairs with score >= *threshold*.
160
161        Parameters
162        ----------
163        threshold : float
164            Minimum score to include.
165
166        Returns
167        -------
168        list of (id1, id2, score)
169            Only the upper-triangle pairs are returned (no duplicates).
170        """
171        if self._matrix is None:
172            return []
173        mat = self._matrix.tocsr() if not self._is_csr else self._matrix
174        cx = mat.tocoo()
175        results = []
176        for i, j, v in zip(cx.row, cx.col, cx.data):
177            if i < j and v >= threshold:  # upper triangle only
178                results.append((self._idx_to_id[i], self._idx_to_id[j], float(v)))
179        return results
180
181    def to_dataframe(self, threshold: float = 0.0) -> pd.DataFrame:
182        """Return pairs above *threshold* as a pandas DataFrame.
183
184        Parameters
185        ----------
186        threshold : float
187            Minimum score to include.  Default 0.0 (all stored pairs).
188
189        Returns
190        -------
191        pandas.DataFrame
192            Columns: ``["id1", "id2", "score"]``.
193        """
194        pairs = self.get_pairs_above_threshold(threshold)
195        return pd.DataFrame(pairs, columns=["id1", "id2", "score"])
196
197    @property
198    def spectrum_ids(self) -> list[str]:
199        """List of registered spectrum IDs in index order."""
200        return list(self._idx_to_id)
201
202    @property
203    def n_spectra(self) -> int:
204        """Number of registered spectra."""
205        return len(self._idx_to_id)
206
207    # ── Persistence ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
208
209    def save(self, path: str):
210        """Save the matrix and ID mapping to a ``.npz`` file.
211
212        Parameters
213        ----------
214        path : str
215            Output file path (will be given ``.npz`` extension if absent).
216        """
217        self.finalise()
218        mat = self._matrix if self._matrix is not None else csr_matrix((0, 0))
219        save_npz(path, mat)
220        # Save ID list alongside
221        ids_path = str(path).replace(".npz", "") + "_ids.npy"
222        np.save(ids_path, np.array(self._idx_to_id, dtype=object))
223
224    @classmethod
225    def load(cls, path: str) -> "SimilarityMatrix":
226        """Load a SimilarityMatrix from a ``.npz`` file.
227
228        Parameters
229        ----------
230        path : str
231            Path to the ``.npz`` file saved by :meth:`save`.
232
233        Returns
234        -------
235        SimilarityMatrix
236        """
237        mat = load_npz(path)
238        ids_path = str(path).replace(".npz", "") + "_ids.npy"
239        ids = list(np.load(ids_path, allow_pickle=True))
240        obj = cls()
241        obj._matrix = mat.tocsr()
242        obj._is_csr = True
243        obj._idx_to_id = ids
244        obj._id_to_idx = {sid: i for i, sid in enumerate(ids)}
245        return obj
246
247    def __repr__(self) -> str:
248        n = self.n_spectra
249        nnz = self._matrix.nnz // 2 if self._matrix is not None else 0
250        return (
251            f"SimilarityMatrix(metric='{self.metric_name}', "
252            f"n_spectra={n}, n_pairs_stored={nnz})"
253        )

156    def get_pairs_above_threshold(
157        self, threshold: float
158    ) -> list[tuple[str, str, float]]:
159        """Return all stored pairs with score >= *threshold*.
160
161        Parameters
162        ----------
163        threshold : float
164            Minimum score to include.
165
166        Returns
167        -------
168        list of (id1, id2, score)
169            Only the upper-triangle pairs are returned (no duplicates).
170        """
171        if self._matrix is None:
172            return []
173        mat = self._matrix.tocsr() if not self._is_csr else self._matrix
174        cx = mat.tocoo()
175        results = []
176        for i, j, v in zip(cx.row, cx.col, cx.data):
177            if i < j and v >= threshold:  # upper triangle only
178                results.append((self._idx_to_id[i], self._idx_to_id[j], float(v)))
179        return results

@classmethod
def load( cls, path: str) -> SimilarityMatrix: 
224    @classmethod
225    def load(cls, path: str) -> "SimilarityMatrix":
226        """Load a SimilarityMatrix from a ``.npz`` file.
227
228        Parameters
229        ----------
230        path : str
231            Path to the ``.npz`` file saved by :meth:`save`.
232
233        Returns
234        -------
235        SimilarityMatrix
236        """
237        mat = load_npz(path)
238        ids_path = str(path).replace(".npz", "") + "_ids.npy"
239        ids = list(np.load(ids_path, allow_pickle=True))
240        obj = cls()
241        obj._matrix = mat.tocsr()
242        obj._is_csr = True
243        obj._idx_to_id = ids
244        obj._id_to_idx = {sid: i for i, sid in enumerate(ids)}
245        return obj
