class SimilarityEngine: 
 167class SimilarityEngine:
 168    """Compute pairwise spectral similarities using FlashEntropy + optional extras.
 169
 170    Parameters
 171    ----------
 172    fe_lib : ms_entropy.FlashEntropySearch or None
 173        Pre-built FlashEntropy search instance.  Pass ``None`` for
 174        query-only mode (only :meth:`compute_all_vs_all_with_lib` with a
 175        temporary index is used; query-vs-library methods are unavailable).
 176        When provided, fragment-tolerance parameters are extracted from this
 177        library unless overridden by *ms2_tolerance_da*.
 178    search_type : str
 179        FlashEntropy search mode: ``"identity"``, ``"open"``, or
 180        ``"neutral_loss"``.  Default ``"open"`` (matches typical DDA
 181        molecular-networking use; use ``"identity"`` when precursor
 182        filtering is required).
 183    additional_similarities : list of str, optional
 184        Extra similarity metrics to compute for pairs that pass the entropy
 185        threshold.  Currently supported: ``["cosine"]``.
 186        Default ``["cosine"]``.  Cosine is a best-effort peak-aligned
 187        score gated by *entropy_threshold_low* (not a second primary engine).
 188    ms1_tolerance_da : float, optional
 189        Precursor m/z tolerance (Da) used **only** for ``"identity"`` search
 190        to filter library candidates by precursor m/z.  Ignored for
 191        ``"open"`` and ``"neutral_loss"`` (precursor filter is disabled for
 192        those modes).  If ``None`` (default), uses 0.01 Da.
 193    ms2_tolerance_da : float, optional
 194        Fragment m/z tolerance (Da) for spectrum cleaning and similarity
 195        scoring.  Resolution priority: explicit kwarg > extracted from
 196        *fe_lib* > 0.01 Da fallback.
 197    entropy_threshold_low : float or None, optional
 198        Minimum entropy similarity score required to trigger additional
 199        metric computation.  If None and *settings* does not supply a value,
 200        default is 0.1.
 201    settings : SpectralSimilaritySearchSettings, optional
 202        Encapsulated spectral-similarity defaults (for example
 203        ``lcms.parameters.mass_spectrum["ms2"].spectral_similarity_search``).
 204        When provided, fills any constructor fields left as ``None``.
 205        Explicit keyword arguments always override *settings*.
 206
 207    Attributes
 208    ----------
 209    ms2_tolerance_da : float
 210        Fragment m/z tolerance resolved at construction time.
 211    peak_sep_da : float
 212        Minimum peak separation used during spectrum cleaning
 213        (``2 * ms2_tolerance_da``).
 214    ms1_tolerance_da : float
 215        Precursor m/z tolerance for identity search.
 216    entropy_threshold_low : float
 217        Low-entropy gate for triggering additional metric computation.
 218
 219    Notes
 220    -----
 221    **Tolerance resolution order** (highest priority first):
 222
 223    1. Explicit *ms2_tolerance_da* kwarg.
 224    2. *settings.ms2_tolerance_da* when *settings* is provided and the kwarg
 225       is omitted.
 226    3. ``fe_lib.entropy_search.max_ms2_tolerance_in_da`` (when *fe_lib* is
 227       not ``None``).
 228    4. Hard-coded fallback of 0.01 Da.
 229
 230    **Precursor filter behaviour by search type:**
 231
 232    - ``"identity"`` : library candidates are filtered by precursor m/z
 233      within *ms1_tolerance_da* before scoring.
 234    - ``"open"`` : precursor filter is disabled (``ms1_tolerance_in_da``
 235      passed to FlashEntropy is set to ``1e9``).
 236    - ``"neutral_loss"`` : precursor filter is disabled for the same reason
 237      as ``"open"``; matching occurs in neutral-loss mass space
 238      (``precursor_mz − fragment_mz``), not on the precursor itself.
 239
 240    Cosine (when requested) runs **single-threaded**: unique spectra are
 241    pre-sorted once, then pairs are scored sequentially via
 242    :func:`_align_and_compute_cosine_presorted`.
 243    """
 244
 245    def __init__(
 246        self,
 247        fe_lib,
 248        search_type: str | None = None,
 249        additional_similarities: list[str] | None = None,
 250        ms1_tolerance_da: float | None = None,
 251        ms2_tolerance_da: float | None = None,
 252        entropy_threshold_low: float | None = None,
 253        settings=None,
 254    ):
 255        if settings is not None:
 256            if search_type is None:
 257                search_type = settings.search_type
 258            if additional_similarities is None:
 259                additional_similarities = list(settings.additional_similarities)
 260            if ms1_tolerance_da is None:
 261                ms1_tolerance_da = settings.ms1_tolerance_da
 262            if ms2_tolerance_da is None:
 263                ms2_tolerance_da = settings.ms2_tolerance_da
 264            if (
 265                entropy_threshold_low is None
 266                and settings.entropy_threshold_low is not None
 267            ):
 268                entropy_threshold_low = settings.entropy_threshold_low
 269            self._settings = settings
 270        else:
 271            self._settings = None
 272
 273        if search_type is None:
 274            search_type = "open"
 275        if search_type not in _FE_METHOD_MAP:
 276            raise ValueError(
 277                f"search_type must be one of {list(_FE_METHOD_MAP.keys())}, "
 278                f"got '{search_type}'."
 279            )
 280        if additional_similarities is None:
 281            additional_similarities = ["cosine"]
 282        unsupported = set(additional_similarities) - _SUPPORTED_ADDITIONAL
 283        if unsupported:
 284            raise ValueError(
 285                f"Unsupported additional_similarities: {unsupported}. "
 286                f"Supported: {_SUPPORTED_ADDITIONAL}"
 287            )
 288
 289        self.fe_lib = fe_lib
 290        self.search_type = search_type
 291        self.additional_similarities = list(additional_similarities)
 292
 293        # Tolerance priority: explicit kwarg > fe_lib extraction > 0.01 fallback.
 294        # When fe_lib is None (queries-only mode), a temporary FE index is built
 295        # from the query spectra themselves; ms2_tolerance_da controls that index.
 296        if ms2_tolerance_da is not None:
 297            self.ms2_tolerance_da = ms2_tolerance_da
 298        elif fe_lib is not None:
 299            self.ms2_tolerance_da = fe_lib.entropy_search.max_ms2_tolerance_in_da
 300        else:
 301            self.ms2_tolerance_da = 0.01
 302        self.peak_sep_da = 2 * self.ms2_tolerance_da
 303        self.ms1_tolerance_da = (
 304            ms1_tolerance_da if ms1_tolerance_da is not None else 0.01
 305        )
 306
 307        self.entropy_threshold_low = (
 308            entropy_threshold_low if entropy_threshold_low is not None else 0.1
 309        )
 310
 311    # ── Internal helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 312
 313    def _peaks_array(self, spectrum) -> np.ndarray:
 314        """Return (N, 2) peaks array from a spectrum object."""
 315        mz = np.asarray(spectrum.mz_exp, dtype=float)
 316        ab = np.asarray(spectrum.abundance, dtype=float)
 317        return np.column_stack((mz, ab))
 318
 319    def _require_precursor_mz(
 320        self,
 321        precursor_mz: float | None,
 322        context: str,
 323    ) -> float:
 324        """Validate precursor m/z and return it as float."""
 325        if precursor_mz is None:
 326            raise ValueError(
 327                f"{context} is missing precursor_mz, which is required for "
 328                f"search_type='{self.search_type}'."
 329            )
 330
 331        precursor = float(precursor_mz)
 332        if not np.isfinite(precursor):
 333            raise ValueError(f"{context} has non-finite precursor_mz={precursor_mz!r}.")
 334        return precursor
 335
 336    def _transform_to_neutral_loss_space(
 337        self,
 338        peaks: np.ndarray,
 339        precursor_mz: float | None,
 340        context: str,
 341    ) -> np.ndarray:
 342        """Transform peaks from fragment m/z to neutral-loss mass space.
 343
 344        Neutral-loss mass is computed as:
 345            neutral_loss_mz = precursor_mz - fragment_mz
 346        """
 347        precursor = self._require_precursor_mz(precursor_mz, context)
 348        peaks = np.asarray(peaks, dtype=float)
 349
 350        if peaks.ndim != 2 or peaks.shape[1] < 2:
 351            raise ValueError(
 352                f"{context} peaks must be a 2D array with at least 2 columns; "
 353                f"got shape={peaks.shape}."
 354            )
 355
 356        if peaks.shape[0] == 0:
 357            return peaks.copy()
 358
 359        # Neutral-loss masses are only valid for fragment_mz <= precursor_mz.
 360        # Drop invalid fragment peaks to mirror the neutral-loss search domain.
 361        valid_mask = peaks[:, 0] <= precursor
 362        if not np.any(valid_mask):
 363            return np.empty((0, peaks.shape[1]), dtype=float)
 364
 365        nl_peaks = peaks[valid_mask].copy()
 366        nl_peaks[:, 0] = precursor - nl_peaks[:, 0]
 367
 368        # Keep deterministic ordering before downstream alignment.
 369        sort_idx = np.argsort(nl_peaks[:, 0])
 370        return nl_peaks[sort_idx]
 371
 372    def _clean_and_search(
 373        self,
 374        peaks: np.ndarray,
 375        precursor_mz: float | None,
 376        fe_lib_override=None,
 377    ) -> np.ndarray:
 378        """Run FlashEntropy search for one query spectrum.
 379
 380        Passes raw peaks directly to FlashEntropy's ``search()`` method,
 381        which cleans the spectrum internally.  This avoids double-cleaning
 382        and ensures the query is processed identically to library entries.
 383
 384        **Precursor filter behaviour:**
 385
 386        - ``"identity"`` : ``ms1_tolerance_in_da`` is set to
 387          :attr:`ms1_tolerance_da` so only library entries within that
 388          precursor window are scored.
 389        - ``"open"`` and ``"neutral_loss"`` : ``ms1_tolerance_in_da`` is
 390          set to ``1e9`` (effectively no filter).  For ``"neutral_loss"``,
 391          matching occurs in neutral-loss mass space internally within
 392          FlashEntropy, so filtering on precursor m/z would incorrectly
 393          exclude valid matches.
 394
 395        For ``"neutral_loss"``, fragment peaks with m/z > precursor m/z are
 396        stripped before the search call (they have no valid neutral-loss
 397        representation).
 398
 399        Parameters
 400        ----------
 401        peaks : np.ndarray of shape (N, 2)
 402            Raw ``[[mz, abundance], ...]`` array.  FlashEntropy cleans this
 403            internally (normalisation, denoising, peak separation).
 404        precursor_mz : float or None
 405            Required for ``"identity"`` and ``"neutral_loss"``; a dummy
 406            value of 0.0 is used for ``"open"`` when ``None`` is passed.
 407        fe_lib_override : ms_entropy.FlashEntropySearch, optional
 408            If provided, search against this library instead of
 409            ``self.fe_lib``.  Used for query-vs-query searches where a
 410            temporary index is built from the query spectra themselves.
 411
 412        Returns
 413        -------
 414        np.ndarray
 415            1-D array of entropy similarity scores, one per library entry.
 416            Returns a zero array if the query has no valid peaks after
 417            pre-filtering.
 418        """
 419        fe_method, fe_key = _FE_METHOD_MAP[self.search_type]
 420        fe = fe_lib_override if fe_lib_override is not None else self.fe_lib
 421
 422        if self.search_type in ("identity", "neutral_loss"):
 423            pmz = self._require_precursor_mz(precursor_mz, "Query spectrum")
 424        else:
 425            # Use a dummy precursor_mz for open search
 426            pmz = precursor_mz if precursor_mz is not None else 0.0
 427
 428        peaks_for_search = peaks
 429        if self.search_type == "neutral_loss":
 430            peaks_for_search = np.asarray(peaks, dtype=float)
 431            if peaks_for_search.ndim != 2 or peaks_for_search.shape[1] < 2:
 432                raise ValueError(
 433                    f"Query spectrum peaks must be 2D with at least 2 columns for neutral_loss search; "
 434                    f"got shape={peaks_for_search.shape}."
 435                )
 436            peaks_for_search = peaks_for_search[peaks_for_search[:, 0] <= pmz]
 437            if peaks_for_search.shape[0] == 0:
 438                try:
 439                    lib_size = len(fe)
 440                except TypeError:
 441                    lib_size = len(getattr(fe, "precursor_mz_array", []))
 442                return np.zeros(lib_size, dtype=float)
 443
 444        # Pass raw peaks to search() - it will clean them internally
 445        # This ensures consistent cleaning between library and query spectra
 446        search_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = dict(
 447            peaks=peaks_for_search,  # Raw peaks - search() will clean them
 448            ms2_tolerance_in_da=self.ms2_tolerance_da,
 449            method={fe_method},
 450            precursor_ions_removal_da=None,
 451            noise_threshold=0.0,  # TODO: get this as an attribute from FE as well
 452            min_ms2_difference_in_da=self.peak_sep_da,
 453            target="cpu",
 454        )
 455        if self.search_type == "identity":
 456            search_kwargs["precursor_mz"] = pmz
 457            search_kwargs["ms1_tolerance_in_da"] = self.ms1_tolerance_da
 458        else:
 459            # open search and neutral_loss: precursor_mz still required by ms_entropy
 460            # API but precursor filtering is disabled (1e9 = no filter).
 461            # For neutral_loss, matching occurs on neutral-loss fragment space, not
 462            # on precursor m/z, so the precursor filter must be disabled.
 463            search_kwargs["precursor_mz"] = pmz
 464            search_kwargs["ms1_tolerance_in_da"] = 1e9  # effectively no filter
 465
 466        results = fe.search(**search_kwargs)
 467        return results[fe_key]
 468
 469    def _compute_cosine_for_query_vs_library(
 470        self,
 471        query_spectrum,
 472        query_precursor_mz: float | None,
 473        library_indices: list[int],
 474    ) -> dict[int, float]:
 475        """Compute cosine similarity for one query against multiple library spectra.
 476
 477        Extracts cleaned peaks directly from the FlashEntropy library to ensure
 478        consistency with entropy similarity calculations.  For
 479        ``"neutral_loss"`` search, both query and library peaks are
 480        transformed to neutral-loss mass space before alignment.
 481
 482        Parameters
 483        ----------
 484        query_spectrum : spectrum object
 485            Query spectrum with ``.mz_exp`` and ``.abundance`` attributes.
 486        query_precursor_mz : float or None
 487            Precursor m/z for the query.  Required for ``"neutral_loss"``
 488            search; used as a dummy 0.0 for ``"open"`` when ``None``.
 489        library_indices : list of int
 490            Indices into ``self.fe_lib`` of the library spectra to score.
 491
 492        Returns
 493        -------
 494        dict mapping int → float
 495            ``{library_idx: cosine_score}`` for all pairs with score > 0.
 496        """
 497        # Get and clean query peaks (same as FlashEntropy does)
 498        query_peaks = self._peaks_array(query_spectrum)
 499        if query_peaks.shape[0] == 0:
 500            return {}
 501
 502        pmz = query_precursor_mz if query_precursor_mz is not None else 0.0
 503        cleaned_query = self.fe_lib.clean_spectrum_for_search(
 504            precursor_mz=pmz,
 505            peaks=query_peaks,
 506            precursor_ions_removal_da=None,
 507            noise_threshold=0.0,
 508            min_ms2_difference_in_da=self.peak_sep_da,
 509        )
 510        cleaned_query = np.asarray(cleaned_query, dtype=float)
 511
 512        if cleaned_query.shape[0] == 0:
 513            return {}
 514
 515        if self.search_type == "neutral_loss":
 516            cleaned_query = self._transform_to_neutral_loss_space(
 517                cleaned_query,
 518                query_precursor_mz,
 519                "Query spectrum",
 520            )
 521
 522        # Sort query once; each library spectrum is sorted once before cosine
 523        query_mz_sorted, query_abun_sorted = _sort_peaks_by_mz(
 524            cleaned_query[:, 0], cleaned_query[:, 1]
 525        )
 526
 527        cosine_scores = {}
 528        for lib_idx in library_indices:
 529            # Extract cleaned peaks from FE library (same as entropy similarity uses)
 530            try:
 531                lib_entry = self.fe_lib[lib_idx]
 532                lib_peaks = np.asarray(lib_entry["peaks"], dtype=float)
 533            except (IndexError, KeyError, TypeError):
 534                continue
 535
 536            if self.search_type == "neutral_loss":
 537                lib_peaks = self._transform_to_neutral_loss_space(
 538                    lib_peaks,
 539                    lib_entry.get("precursor_mz"),
 540                    f"Library spectrum at index {lib_idx}",
 541                )
 542
 543            if lib_peaks.ndim != 2 or lib_peaks.shape[1] < 2 or lib_peaks.shape[0] == 0:
 544                continue
 545
 546            lib_mz_sorted, lib_abun_sorted = _sort_peaks_by_mz(
 547                lib_peaks[:, 0], lib_peaks[:, 1]
 548            )
 549
 550            cosine = _align_and_compute_cosine_presorted(
 551                query_mz_sorted,
 552                query_abun_sorted,
 553                lib_mz_sorted,
 554                lib_abun_sorted,
 555                self.ms2_tolerance_da,
 556            )
 557            if cosine > 0.0:
 558                cosine_scores[lib_idx] = cosine
 559
 560        return cosine_scores
 561
 562    def _compute_entropy_matrix_and_pairs(
 563        self,
 564        spectra: list,
 565        spectrum_ids: list[str],
 566        precursor_mzs: list[float | None],
 567        fe_lib_override=None,
 568    ) -> tuple[dict[tuple[str, str], float], list[tuple[int, int]]]:
 569        """Compute entropy similarity and extract upper-triangle pairs.
 570
 571        Uses FlashEntropy's built-in search to efficiently compute pairwise
 572        similarities. Each spectrum is searched once against the library,
 573        and pairwise scores are extracted from the result vectors.
 574
 575        Streams results directly to sparse storage without building dense matrix.
 576
 577        Parameters
 578        ----------
 579        spectra : list
 580            Spectrum objects with .mz_exp and .abundance attributes.
 581        spectrum_ids : list of str
 582            User-provided IDs, one per spectrum.
 583        precursor_mzs : list of float or None
 584            Precursor m/z for each spectrum.
 585        fe_lib_override : FlashEntropySearch, optional
 586            FlashEntropy library to search against. If None, uses self.fe_lib.
 587
 588        Returns
 589        -------
 590        entropy_pairs : dict mapping (id1, id2) → score
 591            Upper-triangle pairs with score > 0.0
 592        pairs_for_additional : list of (i, j)
 593            Index pairs with score >= entropy_threshold_low (for additional metrics)
 594        """
 595        n = len(spectra)
 596        fe = fe_lib_override if fe_lib_override is not None else self.fe_lib
 597
 598        # Stream results directly to sparse storage (no dense intermediate)
 599        entropy_pairs: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
 600        pairs_for_additional: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
 601
 602        for i, (spec, pmz) in enumerate(zip(spectra, precursor_mzs)):
 603            peaks = self._peaks_array(spec)
 604            if peaks.shape[0] == 0:
 605                continue
 606            # Search against the FE library
 607            result_vec = self._clean_and_search(peaks, pmz, fe_lib_override=fe)
 608
 609            if result_vec is None or len(result_vec) == 0:
 610                continue
 611
 612            # Extract all pairs from result_vec, but only store upper-triangle (j > i)
 613            # result_vec[j] contains the similarity score between spectrum i and library entry j
 614            # When searching within same library (all-vs-all), result_vec has n entries
 615            for j in range(min(len(result_vec), n)):
 616                if j <= i:
 617                    # Skip lower triangle and diagonal to avoid duplicates
 618                    continue
 619                score = float(result_vec[j])
 620                if score > 0.0:
 621                    entropy_pairs[(spectrum_ids[i], spectrum_ids[j])] = score
 622                    if score >= self.entropy_threshold_low:
 623                        pairs_for_additional.append((i, j))
 624
 625        return entropy_pairs, pairs_for_additional
 626
 627    def _compute_cosine_for_pairs(
 628        self,
 629        pairs: list[tuple[int, int]],
 630        lib_indices: list[int | None],
 631        fe_lib_override=None,
 632    ) -> dict[tuple[int, int], float]:
 633        """Compute cosine similarity for a list of (i, j) index pairs.
 634
 635        Extracts cleaned peaks directly from the FlashEntropy library for all
 636        unique spectrum indices referenced in the pairs list.
 637
 638        Parameters
 639        ----------
 640        pairs : list of (i, j)
 641            Index pairs. Both i and j are indices into the lib_indices list.
 642        lib_indices : list of int or None
 643            FlashEntropy library indices. For each index in pairs, lib_indices[index]
 644            gives the FE library position. Cleaned peaks are extracted via
 645            fe_lib[lib_indices[idx]]["peaks"]. All spectra must be indexed.
 646        fe_lib_override : FlashEntropySearch, optional
 647            FlashEntropy library to use. If None, uses self.fe_lib.
 648
 649        Returns
 650        -------
 651        dict mapping (i, j) → cosine score
 652        """
 653        if not pairs:
 654            return {}
 655
 656        # Get FE library
 657        fe = fe_lib_override if fe_lib_override is not None else self.fe_lib
 658
 659        # Extract unique indices from all pairs
 660        unique_indices = {i for i, _ in pairs} | {j for _, j in pairs}
 661
 662        # Extract cleaned peaks once per unique spectrum and sort by m/z once
 663        # so pair scoring can use _align_and_compute_cosine_presorted.
 664        sorted_peaks: dict[int, tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]] = {}
 665        for idx in unique_indices:
 666            if lib_indices[idx] is not None:
 667                spec_dict = fe[lib_indices[idx]]
 668                peaks = np.asarray(spec_dict["peaks"], dtype=float)
 669                if peaks.ndim != 2 or peaks.shape[1] < 2:
 670                    raise ValueError(
 671                        f"Spectrum at library index {lib_indices[idx]} has invalid peaks shape={peaks.shape}."
 672                    )
 673
 674                if self.search_type == "neutral_loss":
 675                    peaks = self._transform_to_neutral_loss_space(
 676                        peaks,
 677                        spec_dict.get("precursor_mz"),
 678                        f"Library spectrum at index {lib_indices[idx]}",
 679                    )
 680
 681                mz_s, ab_s = _sort_peaks_by_mz(peaks[:, 0], peaks[:, 1])
 682                sorted_peaks[idx] = (mz_s, ab_s)
 683            else:
 684                raise ValueError(
 685                    f"Spectrum index {idx} has no library index. "
 686                    "All spectra must be indexed in FlashEntropy library."
 687                )
 688
 689        # Score pairs sequentially with pre-sorted peak arrays
 690        cosine_scores: dict[tuple[int, int], float] = {}
 691        tol = self.ms2_tolerance_da
 692        for i, j in pairs:
 693            mz_i, ab_i = sorted_peaks[i]
 694            mz_j, ab_j = sorted_peaks[j]
 695            cosine_scores[(i, j)] = _align_and_compute_cosine_presorted(
 696                mz_i, ab_i, mz_j, ab_j, tol
 697            )
 698
 699        return cosine_scores
 700
 701    # ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 702
 703    def search_queries_against_library(
 704        self,
 705        query_spectra: list,
 706        query_ids: list[str],
 707        query_precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None,
 708        *,
 709        format_library_id: Callable[[int], str] | None = None,
 710    ) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], float]], int]:
 711        """Search each query spectrum against ``self.fe_lib`` (query–library).
 712
 713        Computes entropy similarity for all library hits with score > 0 and,
 714        when configured, cosine for pairs at or above
 715        :attr:`entropy_threshold_low`.
 716
 717        Parameters
 718        ----------
 719        query_spectra : list
 720            Spectrum objects with ``.mz_exp`` and ``.abundance``.
 721        query_ids : list of str
 722            Unique ID for each query (same length as *query_spectra*).
 723        query_precursor_mzs : list of float or None, optional
 724            Precursor m/z per query.  Required for ``"identity"`` and
 725            ``"neutral_loss"``; optional for ``"open"``.
 726        format_library_id : callable, optional
 727            Maps library index → node ID string used in pair keys.
 728            Default ``str`` (bare index).  Callers that need non-colliding
 729            IDs (e.g. ``MolecularNetwork.library_node_id``) should pass a
 730            formatter.
 731
 732        Returns
 733        -------
 734        scores : dict
 735            ``{metric_name: {(query_id, library_id): score}}`` with
 736            ``"entropy_similarity"`` and optionally ``"cosine"``.
 737        library_size : int
 738            Length of the FlashEntropy result vector (library size used for
 739            registration / indexing).  ``0`` if no successful searches ran.
 740
 741        Raises
 742        ------
 743        RuntimeError
 744            If ``self.fe_lib`` is ``None``.
 745        ValueError
 746            If lengths of *query_ids* / *query_precursor_mzs* do not match
 747            *query_spectra*.
 748        """
 749        if self.fe_lib is None:
 750            raise RuntimeError(
 751                "search_queries_against_library requires a reference FE library "
 752                "(fe_lib)."
 753            )
 754
 755        n_query = len(query_spectra)
 756        if len(query_ids) != n_query:
 757            raise ValueError(
 758                f"query_ids length ({len(query_ids)}) must match "
 759                f"query_spectra length ({n_query})."
 760            )
 761        if query_precursor_mzs is None:
 762            query_precursor_mzs = [None] * n_query
 763        elif len(query_precursor_mzs) != n_query:
 764            raise ValueError(
 765                f"query_precursor_mzs length ({len(query_precursor_mzs)}) must match "
 766                f"query_spectra length ({n_query})."
 767            )
 768
 769        id_fmt = format_library_id if format_library_id is not None else str
 770
 771        entropy_pairs: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
 772        cosine_pairs: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
 773        query_to_lib_indices: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
 774        library_size = 0
 775
 776        for qi, (spec, pmz) in enumerate(zip(query_spectra, query_precursor_mzs)):
 777            peaks = self._peaks_array(spec)
 778            if peaks.shape[0] == 0:
 779                continue
 780            result_vec = self._clean_and_search(peaks, pmz)
 781            if result_vec is None:
 782                continue
 783            library_size = max(library_size, len(result_vec))
 784
 785            lib_indices_for_query: list[int] = []
 786            for lib_idx, score in enumerate(result_vec):
 787                if score > 0.0:
 788                    entropy_pairs[(query_ids[qi], id_fmt(lib_idx))] = float(score)
 789                    if score >= self.entropy_threshold_low:
 790                        lib_indices_for_query.append(lib_idx)
 791
 792            if lib_indices_for_query:
 793                query_to_lib_indices[qi] = lib_indices_for_query
 794
 795        if "cosine" in self.additional_similarities and query_to_lib_indices:
 796            for qi, lib_indices in query_to_lib_indices.items():
 797                cosine_scores = self._compute_cosine_for_query_vs_library(
 798                    query_spectrum=query_spectra[qi],
 799                    query_precursor_mz=query_precursor_mzs[qi],
 800                    library_indices=lib_indices,
 801                )
 802                for lib_idx, score in cosine_scores.items():
 803                    cosine_pairs[(query_ids[qi], id_fmt(lib_idx))] = score
 804
 805        scores: dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], float]] = {
 806            "entropy_similarity": entropy_pairs
 807        }
 808        if cosine_pairs:
 809            scores["cosine"] = cosine_pairs
 810
 811        return scores, library_size
 812
 813    def build_fe_index_from_spectra(
 814        self,
 815        spectra: list,
 816        precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None,
 817        fe_kwargs: dict | None = None,
 818    ):
 819        """Build a FlashEntropy search index from a list of spectrum objects.
 820
 821        This is used to create a temporary index from query spectra so that
 822        query-vs-query similarities can be computed without requiring the
 823        spectra to already be in the main library.
 824
 825        Parameters
 826        ----------
 827        spectra : list
 828            Spectrum objects with ``.mz_exp`` and ``.abundance`` attributes.
 829        precursor_mzs : list of float or None, optional
 830            Precursor m/z for each spectrum.  Used as the ``precursor_mz``
 831            field in the FlashEntropy library.  Defaults to 0.0 for each.
 832        fe_kwargs : dict, optional
 833            Extra keyword arguments forwarded to ``FlashEntropySearch``.
 834            Defaults to the same settings used for the main library.
 835
 836        Returns
 837        -------
 838        ms_entropy.FlashEntropySearch
 839            A new FlashEntropy search instance indexed on *spectra*.
 840        """
 841        try:
 842            from ms_entropy import FlashEntropySearch
 843        except ImportError:
 844            raise ImportError(
 845                "ms_entropy is required for build_fe_index_from_spectra(). "
 846                "Install with: pip install ms_entropy"
 847            )
 848
 849        if precursor_mzs is None:
 850            precursor_mzs = [None] * len(spectra)
 851
 852        # Default FE kwargs mirror the main library settings
 853        # Extract build_index parameters from the main FE library if available
 854        # (these are stored as custom attributes by _build_flash_entropy_index)
 855        default_fe_kwargs = {
 856            "normalize_intensity": True,
 857            "min_ms2_difference_in_da": self.peak_sep_da,  # Already 2x tolerance from extraction
 858            "max_ms2_tolerance_in_da": self.ms2_tolerance_da,
 859            "max_indexed_mz": getattr(self.fe_lib, "_build_max_indexed_mz", 3000),
 860            "precursor_ions_removal_da": getattr(
 861                self.fe_lib, "_build_precursor_ions_removal_da", None
 862            ),
 863            "noise_threshold": getattr(self.fe_lib, "_build_noise_threshold", 0),
 864        }
 865        if fe_kwargs:
 866            default_fe_kwargs.update(fe_kwargs)
 867
 868        # Build the spectral library list
 869        spectral_library = []
 870        for i, (spec, pmz) in enumerate(zip(spectra, precursor_mzs)):
 871            peaks = self._peaks_array(spec)
 872            if peaks.shape[0] == 0:
 873                continue
 874            spectral_library.append(
 875                {
 876                    "id": i,
 877                    "precursor_mz": float(pmz) if pmz is not None else 0.0,
 878                    "peaks": peaks.tolist(),
 879                }
 880            )
 881
 882        # Match the FlashEntropy constructor/init and build_index signature
 883        fe_init_kws = [
 884            "max_ms2_tolerance_in_da",
 885            "mz_index_step",
 886            "low_memory",
 887            "path_data",
 888        ]
 889        fe_init_kws = {k: v for k, v in default_fe_kwargs.items() if k in fe_init_kws}
 890
 891        fe = FlashEntropySearch(**fe_init_kws)
 892
 893        fe_index_kws = [
 894            "max_indexed_mz",
 895            "precursor_ions_removal_da",
 896            "noise_threshold",
 897            "min_ms2_difference_in_da",
 898            "max_peak_num",
 899        ]
 900        fe_index_kws = {k: v for k, v in default_fe_kwargs.items() if k in fe_index_kws}
 901
 902        fe.build_index(spectral_library, **fe_index_kws, clean_spectra=True)
 903        return fe
 904
 905    def compute_library_vs_library_filtered(
 906        self,
 907        library_indices: list[int],
 908        spectrum_ids: list[str],
 909        precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None,
 910    ) -> dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], float]]:
 911        """Compute library-vs-library similarities for a filtered subset of library spectra.
 912
 913        Extracts the spectra at *library_indices* from ``self.fe_lib``, builds a
 914        temporary FlashEntropy index from them, and computes all-vs-all pairwise
 915        similarities within that subset.
 916
 917        Parameters
 918        ----------
 919        library_indices : list of int
 920            Indices into ``self.fe_lib`` of the library spectra to include.
 921        spectrum_ids : list of str
 922            IDs to assign to each library spectrum (must be same length as
 923            *library_indices*).
 924        precursor_mzs : list of float or None, optional
 925            Precursor m/z for each library spectrum.  If None, attempts to read
 926            from ``self.fe_lib`` (attribute ``precursor_mz`` on each entry), or
 927            defaults to 0.0.
 928
 929        Returns
 930        -------
 931        dict
 932            ``{metric_name: {(id1, id2): score}}``
 933            All-vs-all pairs within the filtered library subset.
 934        """
 935        n = len(library_indices)
 936        if n == 0:
 937            return {}
 938
 939        if self.fe_lib is None:
 940            raise RuntimeError(
 941                "compute_library_vs_library_filtered requires a reference FE library "
 942                "(fe_lib)."
 943            )
 944
 945        if len(spectrum_ids) != n:
 946            raise ValueError(
 947                f"spectrum_ids length ({len(spectrum_ids)}) must match "
 948                f"library_indices length ({n})."
 949            )
 950        if precursor_mzs is not None and len(precursor_mzs) != n:
 951            raise ValueError(
 952                f"precursor_mzs length ({len(precursor_mzs)}) must match "
 953                f"library_indices length ({n})."
 954            )
 955
 956        # Build lightweight spectrum objects from the raw library entries
 957        class _LibSpec:
 958            __slots__ = ("mz_exp", "abundance")
 959
 960            def __init__(self, peaks_arr):
 961                self.mz_exp = peaks_arr[:, 0]
 962                self.abundance = peaks_arr[:, 1]
 963
 964        lib_spectra: list = []
 965        lib_precursor_mzs: list[float | None] = []
 966        # IDs for successfully extracted entries only (same order as lib_spectra)
 967        valid_ids: list[str] = []
 968
 969        for i, idx in enumerate(library_indices):
 970            try:
 971                entry = self.fe_lib[idx]
 972            except (IndexError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
 973                raise ValueError(f"Cannot read library entry at index {idx}.") from exc
 974
 975            if not isinstance(entry, dict):
 976                raise TypeError(
 977                    f"Library entry at index {idx} must be a dict; "
 978                    f"got {type(entry).__name__}."
 979                )
 980
 981            peaks = np.asarray(entry.get("peaks", []), dtype=float)
 982            # Skip empty/invalid peak tables but keep spectrum_ids/precursors
 983            # aligned to the original index *i* for survivors (not first-N trim).
 984            if peaks.ndim != 2 or peaks.shape[1] < 2 or peaks.shape[0] == 0:
 985                continue
 986
 987            lib_spectra.append(_LibSpec(peaks))
 988            valid_ids.append(spectrum_ids[i])
 989            if precursor_mzs is not None:
 990                lib_precursor_mzs.append(precursor_mzs[i])
 991            else:
 992                lib_precursor_mzs.append(float(entry.get("precursor_mz", 0.0) or 0.0))
 993
 994        if not lib_spectra:
 995            return {}
 996
 997        # Build a temporary FE index from the filtered library spectra
 998        temp_fe = self.build_fe_index_from_spectra(
 999            spectra=lib_spectra,
1000            precursor_mzs=lib_precursor_mzs,
1001        )
1002
1003        # Compute all-vs-all using the temporary index
1004        return self.compute_all_vs_all_with_lib(
1005            spectra=lib_spectra,
1006            spectrum_ids=valid_ids,
1007            precursor_mzs=lib_precursor_mzs,
1008            fe_lib_override=temp_fe,
1009        )
1010
1011    def compute_all_vs_all_with_lib(
1012        self,
1013        spectra: list,
1014        spectrum_ids: list[str],
1015        precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None,
1016        fe_lib_override=None,
1017    ) -> dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], float]]:
1018        """Compute all-vs-all pairwise similarities using a provided FE library.
1019
1020        Canonical all-vs-all path: each spectrum is searched once against the
1021        FlashEntropy index (*fe_lib_override* or ``self.fe_lib``), and
1022        upper-triangle pairwise scores are extracted from the result vectors.
1023
1024        Parameters
1025        ----------
1026        spectra : list
1027            Spectrum objects with .mz_exp and .abundance attributes.
1028        spectrum_ids : list of str
1029            User-provided IDs, one per spectrum.
1030        precursor_mzs : list of float or None, optional
1031            Precursor m/z for each spectrum.
1032        fe_lib_override : ms_entropy.FlashEntropySearch, optional
1033            FlashEntropy library to search against.  If None, falls back to
1034            ``self.fe_lib``.
1035
1036        Returns
1037        -------
1038        dict
1039            ``{metric_name: {(id1, id2): score}}``
1040        """
1041        n = len(spectra)
1042        if n == 0:
1043            return {}
1044
1045        if precursor_mzs is None:
1046            precursor_mzs = [None] * n
1047
1048        # Library indices are simply 0..n-1 (positions in fe_lib_override)
1049        lib_indices = list(range(n))
1050
1051        # ── Stage 1: Compute entropy similarity matrix using FE search ────────
1052        entropy_pairs, pairs_for_additional = self._compute_entropy_matrix_and_pairs(
1053            spectra, spectrum_ids, precursor_mzs, fe_lib_override
1054        )
1055
1056        result: dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], float]] = {
1057            "entropy_similarity": entropy_pairs
1058        }
1059
1060        # ── Stage 2: Compute additional metrics for pairs above threshold ────
1061        fe = fe_lib_override if fe_lib_override is not None else self.fe_lib
1062        for metric in self.additional_similarities:
1063            if metric == "cosine":
1064                cosine_idx_scores = self._compute_cosine_for_pairs(
1065                    pairs_for_additional,
1066                    lib_indices,
1067                    fe_lib_override=fe,
1068                )
1069                result["cosine"] = {
1070                    (spectrum_ids[i], spectrum_ids[j]): score
1071                    for (i, j), score in cosine_idx_scores.items()
1072                }
1073
1074        return result

Compute pairwise spectral similarities using FlashEntropy + optional extras.

Parameters
  • fe_lib (ms_entropy.FlashEntropySearch or None): Pre-built FlashEntropy search instance. Pass None for query-only mode (only compute_all_vs_all_with_lib() with a temporary index is used; query-vs-library methods are unavailable). When provided, fragment-tolerance parameters are extracted from this library unless overridden by ms2_tolerance_da.
  • search_type (str): FlashEntropy search mode: "identity", "open", or "neutral_loss". Default "open" (matches typical DDA molecular-networking use; use "identity" when precursor filtering is required).
  • additional_similarities (list of str, optional): Extra similarity metrics to compute for pairs that pass the entropy threshold. Currently supported: ["cosine"]. Default ["cosine"]. Cosine is a best-effort peak-aligned score gated by entropy_threshold_low (not a second primary engine).
  • ms1_tolerance_da (float, optional): Precursor m/z tolerance (Da) used only for "identity" search to filter library candidates by precursor m/z. Ignored for "open" and "neutral_loss" (precursor filter is disabled for those modes). If None (default), uses 0.01 Da.
  • ms2_tolerance_da (float, optional): Fragment m/z tolerance (Da) for spectrum cleaning and similarity scoring. Resolution priority: explicit kwarg > extracted from fe_lib > 0.01 Da fallback.
  • entropy_threshold_low (float or None, optional): Minimum entropy similarity score required to trigger additional metric computation. If None and settings does not supply a value, default is 0.1.
  • settings (SpectralSimilaritySearchSettings, optional): Encapsulated spectral-similarity defaults (for example lcms.parameters.mass_spectrum["ms2"].spectral_similarity_search). When provided, fills any constructor fields left as None. Explicit keyword arguments always override settings.
Attributes
  • ms2_tolerance_da (float): Fragment m/z tolerance resolved at construction time.
  • peak_sep_da (float): Minimum peak separation used during spectrum cleaning (2 * ms2_tolerance_da).
  • ms1_tolerance_da (float): Precursor m/z tolerance for identity search.
  • entropy_threshold_low (float): Low-entropy gate for triggering additional metric computation.
Notes

Tolerance resolution order (highest priority first):

  1. Explicit ms2_tolerance_da kwarg.
  2. settings.ms2_tolerance_da when settings is provided and the kwarg is omitted.
  3. fe_lib.entropy_search.max_ms2_tolerance_in_da (when fe_lib is not None).
  4. Hard-coded fallback of 0.01 Da.

Precursor filter behaviour by search type:

  • "identity" : library candidates are filtered by precursor m/z within ms1_tolerance_da before scoring.
  • "open" : precursor filter is disabled (ms1_tolerance_in_da passed to FlashEntropy is set to 1e9).
  • "neutral_loss" : precursor filter is disabled for the same reason as "open"; matching occurs in neutral-loss mass space (precursor_mz − fragment_mz), not on the precursor itself.

Cosine (when requested) runs single-threaded: unique spectra are pre-sorted once, then pairs are scored sequentially via _align_and_compute_cosine_presorted().

SimilarityEngine( fe_lib, search_type: str | None = None, additional_similarities: list[str] | None = None, ms1_tolerance_da: float | None = None, ms2_tolerance_da: float | None = None, entropy_threshold_low: float | None = None, settings=None) 
245    def __init__(
246        self,
247        fe_lib,
248        search_type: str | None = None,
249        additional_similarities: list[str] | None = None,
250        ms1_tolerance_da: float | None = None,
251        ms2_tolerance_da: float | None = None,
252        entropy_threshold_low: float | None = None,
253        settings=None,
254    ):
255        if settings is not None:
256            if search_type is None:
257                search_type = settings.search_type
258            if additional_similarities is None:
259                additional_similarities = list(settings.additional_similarities)
260            if ms1_tolerance_da is None:
261                ms1_tolerance_da = settings.ms1_tolerance_da
262            if ms2_tolerance_da is None:
263                ms2_tolerance_da = settings.ms2_tolerance_da
264            if (
265                entropy_threshold_low is None
266                and settings.entropy_threshold_low is not None
267            ):
268                entropy_threshold_low = settings.entropy_threshold_low
269            self._settings = settings
270        else:
271            self._settings = None
272
273        if search_type is None:
274            search_type = "open"
275        if search_type not in _FE_METHOD_MAP:
276            raise ValueError(
277                f"search_type must be one of {list(_FE_METHOD_MAP.keys())}, "
278                f"got '{search_type}'."
279            )
280        if additional_similarities is None:
281            additional_similarities = ["cosine"]
282        unsupported = set(additional_similarities) - _SUPPORTED_ADDITIONAL
283        if unsupported:
284            raise ValueError(
285                f"Unsupported additional_similarities: {unsupported}. "
286                f"Supported: {_SUPPORTED_ADDITIONAL}"
287            )
288
289        self.fe_lib = fe_lib
290        self.search_type = search_type
291        self.additional_similarities = list(additional_similarities)
292
293        # Tolerance priority: explicit kwarg > fe_lib extraction > 0.01 fallback.
294        # When fe_lib is None (queries-only mode), a temporary FE index is built
295        # from the query spectra themselves; ms2_tolerance_da controls that index.
296        if ms2_tolerance_da is not None:
297            self.ms2_tolerance_da = ms2_tolerance_da
298        elif fe_lib is not None:
299            self.ms2_tolerance_da = fe_lib.entropy_search.max_ms2_tolerance_in_da
300        else:
301            self.ms2_tolerance_da = 0.01
302        self.peak_sep_da = 2 * self.ms2_tolerance_da
303        self.ms1_tolerance_da = (
304            ms1_tolerance_da if ms1_tolerance_da is not None else 0.01
305        )
306
307        self.entropy_threshold_low = (
308            entropy_threshold_low if entropy_threshold_low is not None else 0.1
309        )
fe_lib
search_type
additional_similarities
peak_sep_da
ms1_tolerance_da
entropy_threshold_low
def search_queries_against_library( self, query_spectra: list, query_ids: list[str], query_precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None, *, format_library_id: Callable[[int], str] | None = None) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], float]], int]: 
703    def search_queries_against_library(
704        self,
705        query_spectra: list,
706        query_ids: list[str],
707        query_precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None,
708        *,
709        format_library_id: Callable[[int], str] | None = None,
710    ) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], float]], int]:
711        """Search each query spectrum against ``self.fe_lib`` (query–library).
712
713        Computes entropy similarity for all library hits with score > 0 and,
714        when configured, cosine for pairs at or above
715        :attr:`entropy_threshold_low`.
716
717        Parameters
718        ----------
719        query_spectra : list
720            Spectrum objects with ``.mz_exp`` and ``.abundance``.
721        query_ids : list of str
722            Unique ID for each query (same length as *query_spectra*).
723        query_precursor_mzs : list of float or None, optional
724            Precursor m/z per query.  Required for ``"identity"`` and
725            ``"neutral_loss"``; optional for ``"open"``.
726        format_library_id : callable, optional
727            Maps library index → node ID string used in pair keys.
728            Default ``str`` (bare index).  Callers that need non-colliding
729            IDs (e.g. ``MolecularNetwork.library_node_id``) should pass a
730            formatter.
731
732        Returns
733        -------
734        scores : dict
735            ``{metric_name: {(query_id, library_id): score}}`` with
736            ``"entropy_similarity"`` and optionally ``"cosine"``.
737        library_size : int
738            Length of the FlashEntropy result vector (library size used for
739            registration / indexing).  ``0`` if no successful searches ran.
740
741        Raises
742        ------
743        RuntimeError
744            If ``self.fe_lib`` is ``None``.
745        ValueError
746            If lengths of *query_ids* / *query_precursor_mzs* do not match
747            *query_spectra*.
748        """
749        if self.fe_lib is None:
750            raise RuntimeError(
751                "search_queries_against_library requires a reference FE library "
752                "(fe_lib)."
753            )
754
755        n_query = len(query_spectra)
756        if len(query_ids) != n_query:
757            raise ValueError(
758                f"query_ids length ({len(query_ids)}) must match "
759                f"query_spectra length ({n_query})."
760            )
761        if query_precursor_mzs is None:
762            query_precursor_mzs = [None] * n_query
763        elif len(query_precursor_mzs) != n_query:
764            raise ValueError(
765                f"query_precursor_mzs length ({len(query_precursor_mzs)}) must match "
766                f"query_spectra length ({n_query})."
767            )
768
769        id_fmt = format_library_id if format_library_id is not None else str
770
771        entropy_pairs: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
772        cosine_pairs: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
773        query_to_lib_indices: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
774        library_size = 0
775
776        for qi, (spec, pmz) in enumerate(zip(query_spectra, query_precursor_mzs)):
777            peaks = self._peaks_array(spec)
778            if peaks.shape[0] == 0:
779                continue
780            result_vec = self._clean_and_search(peaks, pmz)
781            if result_vec is None:
782                continue
783            library_size = max(library_size, len(result_vec))
784
785            lib_indices_for_query: list[int] = []
786            for lib_idx, score in enumerate(result_vec):
787                if score > 0.0:
788                    entropy_pairs[(query_ids[qi], id_fmt(lib_idx))] = float(score)
789                    if score >= self.entropy_threshold_low:
790                        lib_indices_for_query.append(lib_idx)
791
792            if lib_indices_for_query:
793                query_to_lib_indices[qi] = lib_indices_for_query
794
795        if "cosine" in self.additional_similarities and query_to_lib_indices:
796            for qi, lib_indices in query_to_lib_indices.items():
797                cosine_scores = self._compute_cosine_for_query_vs_library(
798                    query_spectrum=query_spectra[qi],
799                    query_precursor_mz=query_precursor_mzs[qi],
800                    library_indices=lib_indices,
801                )
802                for lib_idx, score in cosine_scores.items():
803                    cosine_pairs[(query_ids[qi], id_fmt(lib_idx))] = score
804
805        scores: dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], float]] = {
806            "entropy_similarity": entropy_pairs
807        }
808        if cosine_pairs:
809            scores["cosine"] = cosine_pairs
810
811        return scores, library_size

Search each query spectrum against self.fe_lib (query–library).

Computes entropy similarity for all library hits with score > 0 and, when configured, cosine for pairs at or above entropy_threshold_low.

Parameters
  • query_spectra (list): Spectrum objects with .mz_exp and .abundance.
  • query_ids (list of str): Unique ID for each query (same length as query_spectra).
  • query_precursor_mzs (list of float or None, optional): Precursor m/z per query. Required for "identity" and "neutral_loss"; optional for "open".
  • format_library_id (callable, optional): Maps library index → node ID string used in pair keys. Default str (bare index). Callers that need non-colliding IDs (e.g. MolecularNetwork.library_node_id) should pass a formatter.
Returns
  • scores (dict): {metric_name: {(query_id, library_id): score}} with "entropy_similarity" and optionally "cosine".
  • library_size (int): Length of the FlashEntropy result vector (library size used for registration / indexing). 0 if no successful searches ran.
Raises
  • RuntimeError: If self.fe_lib is None.
  • ValueError: If lengths of query_ids / query_precursor_mzs do not match query_spectra.
def build_fe_index_from_spectra( self, spectra: list, precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None, fe_kwargs: dict | None = None): 
813    def build_fe_index_from_spectra(
814        self,
815        spectra: list,
816        precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None,
817        fe_kwargs: dict | None = None,
818    ):
819        """Build a FlashEntropy search index from a list of spectrum objects.
820
821        This is used to create a temporary index from query spectra so that
822        query-vs-query similarities can be computed without requiring the
823        spectra to already be in the main library.
824
825        Parameters
826        ----------
827        spectra : list
828            Spectrum objects with ``.mz_exp`` and ``.abundance`` attributes.
829        precursor_mzs : list of float or None, optional
830            Precursor m/z for each spectrum.  Used as the ``precursor_mz``
831            field in the FlashEntropy library.  Defaults to 0.0 for each.
832        fe_kwargs : dict, optional
833            Extra keyword arguments forwarded to ``FlashEntropySearch``.
834            Defaults to the same settings used for the main library.
835
836        Returns
837        -------
838        ms_entropy.FlashEntropySearch
839            A new FlashEntropy search instance indexed on *spectra*.
840        """
841        try:
842            from ms_entropy import FlashEntropySearch
843        except ImportError:
844            raise ImportError(
845                "ms_entropy is required for build_fe_index_from_spectra(). "
846                "Install with: pip install ms_entropy"
847            )
848
849        if precursor_mzs is None:
850            precursor_mzs = [None] * len(spectra)
851
852        # Default FE kwargs mirror the main library settings
853        # Extract build_index parameters from the main FE library if available
854        # (these are stored as custom attributes by _build_flash_entropy_index)
855        default_fe_kwargs = {
856            "normalize_intensity": True,
857            "min_ms2_difference_in_da": self.peak_sep_da,  # Already 2x tolerance from extraction
858            "max_ms2_tolerance_in_da": self.ms2_tolerance_da,
859            "max_indexed_mz": getattr(self.fe_lib, "_build_max_indexed_mz", 3000),
860            "precursor_ions_removal_da": getattr(
861                self.fe_lib, "_build_precursor_ions_removal_da", None
862            ),
863            "noise_threshold": getattr(self.fe_lib, "_build_noise_threshold", 0),
864        }
865        if fe_kwargs:
866            default_fe_kwargs.update(fe_kwargs)
867
868        # Build the spectral library list
869        spectral_library = []
870        for i, (spec, pmz) in enumerate(zip(spectra, precursor_mzs)):
871            peaks = self._peaks_array(spec)
872            if peaks.shape[0] == 0:
873                continue
874            spectral_library.append(
875                {
876                    "id": i,
877                    "precursor_mz": float(pmz) if pmz is not None else 0.0,
878                    "peaks": peaks.tolist(),
879                }
880            )
881
882        # Match the FlashEntropy constructor/init and build_index signature
883        fe_init_kws = [
884            "max_ms2_tolerance_in_da",
885            "mz_index_step",
886            "low_memory",
887            "path_data",
888        ]
889        fe_init_kws = {k: v for k, v in default_fe_kwargs.items() if k in fe_init_kws}
890
891        fe = FlashEntropySearch(**fe_init_kws)
892
893        fe_index_kws = [
894            "max_indexed_mz",
895            "precursor_ions_removal_da",
896            "noise_threshold",
897            "min_ms2_difference_in_da",
898            "max_peak_num",
899        ]
900        fe_index_kws = {k: v for k, v in default_fe_kwargs.items() if k in fe_index_kws}
901
902        fe.build_index(spectral_library, **fe_index_kws, clean_spectra=True)
903        return fe

Build a FlashEntropy search index from a list of spectrum objects.

This is used to create a temporary index from query spectra so that query-vs-query similarities can be computed without requiring the spectra to already be in the main library.

Parameters
  • spectra (list): Spectrum objects with .mz_exp and .abundance attributes.
  • precursor_mzs (list of float or None, optional): Precursor m/z for each spectrum. Used as the precursor_mz field in the FlashEntropy library. Defaults to 0.0 for each.
  • fe_kwargs (dict, optional): Extra keyword arguments forwarded to FlashEntropySearch. Defaults to the same settings used for the main library.
Returns
  • ms_entropy.FlashEntropySearch: A new FlashEntropy search instance indexed on spectra.
def compute_library_vs_library_filtered( self, library_indices: list[int], spectrum_ids: list[str], precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None) -> dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], float]]: 
 905    def compute_library_vs_library_filtered(
 906        self,
 907        library_indices: list[int],
 908        spectrum_ids: list[str],
 909        precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None,
 910    ) -> dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], float]]:
 911        """Compute library-vs-library similarities for a filtered subset of library spectra.
 912
 913        Extracts the spectra at *library_indices* from ``self.fe_lib``, builds a
 914        temporary FlashEntropy index from them, and computes all-vs-all pairwise
 915        similarities within that subset.
 916
 917        Parameters
 918        ----------
 919        library_indices : list of int
 920            Indices into ``self.fe_lib`` of the library spectra to include.
 921        spectrum_ids : list of str
 922            IDs to assign to each library spectrum (must be same length as
 923            *library_indices*).
 924        precursor_mzs : list of float or None, optional
 925            Precursor m/z for each library spectrum.  If None, attempts to read
 926            from ``self.fe_lib`` (attribute ``precursor_mz`` on each entry), or
 927            defaults to 0.0.
 928
 929        Returns
 930        -------
 931        dict
 932            ``{metric_name: {(id1, id2): score}}``
 933            All-vs-all pairs within the filtered library subset.
 934        """
 935        n = len(library_indices)
 936        if n == 0:
 937            return {}
 938
 939        if self.fe_lib is None:
 940            raise RuntimeError(
 941                "compute_library_vs_library_filtered requires a reference FE library "
 942                "(fe_lib)."
 943            )
 944
 945        if len(spectrum_ids) != n:
 946            raise ValueError(
 947                f"spectrum_ids length ({len(spectrum_ids)}) must match "
 948                f"library_indices length ({n})."
 949            )
 950        if precursor_mzs is not None and len(precursor_mzs) != n:
 951            raise ValueError(
 952                f"precursor_mzs length ({len(precursor_mzs)}) must match "
 953                f"library_indices length ({n})."
 954            )
 955
 956        # Build lightweight spectrum objects from the raw library entries
 957        class _LibSpec:
 958            __slots__ = ("mz_exp", "abundance")
 959
 960            def __init__(self, peaks_arr):
 961                self.mz_exp = peaks_arr[:, 0]
 962                self.abundance = peaks_arr[:, 1]
 963
 964        lib_spectra: list = []
 965        lib_precursor_mzs: list[float | None] = []
 966        # IDs for successfully extracted entries only (same order as lib_spectra)
 967        valid_ids: list[str] = []
 968
 969        for i, idx in enumerate(library_indices):
 970            try:
 971                entry = self.fe_lib[idx]
 972            except (IndexError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
 973                raise ValueError(f"Cannot read library entry at index {idx}.") from exc
 974
 975            if not isinstance(entry, dict):
 976                raise TypeError(
 977                    f"Library entry at index {idx} must be a dict; "
 978                    f"got {type(entry).__name__}."
 979                )
 980
 981            peaks = np.asarray(entry.get("peaks", []), dtype=float)
 982            # Skip empty/invalid peak tables but keep spectrum_ids/precursors
 983            # aligned to the original index *i* for survivors (not first-N trim).
 984            if peaks.ndim != 2 or peaks.shape[1] < 2 or peaks.shape[0] == 0:
 985                continue
 986
 987            lib_spectra.append(_LibSpec(peaks))
 988            valid_ids.append(spectrum_ids[i])
 989            if precursor_mzs is not None:
 990                lib_precursor_mzs.append(precursor_mzs[i])
 991            else:
 992                lib_precursor_mzs.append(float(entry.get("precursor_mz", 0.0) or 0.0))
 993
 994        if not lib_spectra:
 995            return {}
 996
 997        # Build a temporary FE index from the filtered library spectra
 998        temp_fe = self.build_fe_index_from_spectra(
 999            spectra=lib_spectra,
1000            precursor_mzs=lib_precursor_mzs,
1001        )
1002
1003        # Compute all-vs-all using the temporary index
1004        return self.compute_all_vs_all_with_lib(
1005            spectra=lib_spectra,
1006            spectrum_ids=valid_ids,
1007            precursor_mzs=lib_precursor_mzs,
1008            fe_lib_override=temp_fe,
1009        )

Compute library-vs-library similarities for a filtered subset of library spectra.

Extracts the spectra at library_indices from self.fe_lib, builds a temporary FlashEntropy index from them, and computes all-vs-all pairwise similarities within that subset.

Parameters
  • library_indices (list of int): Indices into self.fe_lib of the library spectra to include.
  • spectrum_ids (list of str): IDs to assign to each library spectrum (must be same length as library_indices).
  • precursor_mzs (list of float or None, optional): Precursor m/z for each library spectrum. If None, attempts to read from self.fe_lib (attribute precursor_mz on each entry), or defaults to 0.0.
Returns
  • dict: {metric_name: {(id1, id2): score}} All-vs-all pairs within the filtered library subset.
def compute_all_vs_all_with_lib( self, spectra: list, spectrum_ids: list[str], precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None, fe_lib_override=None) -> dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], float]]: 
1011    def compute_all_vs_all_with_lib(
1012        self,
1013        spectra: list,
1014        spectrum_ids: list[str],
1015        precursor_mzs: list[float | None] | None = None,
1016        fe_lib_override=None,
1017    ) -> dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], float]]:
1018        """Compute all-vs-all pairwise similarities using a provided FE library.
1019
1020        Canonical all-vs-all path: each spectrum is searched once against the
1021        FlashEntropy index (*fe_lib_override* or ``self.fe_lib``), and
1022        upper-triangle pairwise scores are extracted from the result vectors.
1023
1024        Parameters
1025        ----------
1026        spectra : list
1027            Spectrum objects with .mz_exp and .abundance attributes.
1028        spectrum_ids : list of str
1029            User-provided IDs, one per spectrum.
1030        precursor_mzs : list of float or None, optional
1031            Precursor m/z for each spectrum.
1032        fe_lib_override : ms_entropy.FlashEntropySearch, optional
1033            FlashEntropy library to search against.  If None, falls back to
1034            ``self.fe_lib``.
1035
1036        Returns
1037        -------
1038        dict
1039            ``{metric_name: {(id1, id2): score}}``
1040        """
1041        n = len(spectra)
1042        if n == 0:
1043            return {}
1044
1045        if precursor_mzs is None:
1046            precursor_mzs = [None] * n
1047
1048        # Library indices are simply 0..n-1 (positions in fe_lib_override)
1049        lib_indices = list(range(n))
1050
1051        # ── Stage 1: Compute entropy similarity matrix using FE search ────────
1052        entropy_pairs, pairs_for_additional = self._compute_entropy_matrix_and_pairs(
1053            spectra, spectrum_ids, precursor_mzs, fe_lib_override
1054        )
1055
1056        result: dict[str, dict[tuple[str, str], float]] = {
1057            "entropy_similarity": entropy_pairs
1058        }
1059
1060        # ── Stage 2: Compute additional metrics for pairs above threshold ────
1061        fe = fe_lib_override if fe_lib_override is not None else self.fe_lib
1062        for metric in self.additional_similarities:
1063            if metric == "cosine":
1064                cosine_idx_scores = self._compute_cosine_for_pairs(
1065                    pairs_for_additional,
1066                    lib_indices,
1067                    fe_lib_override=fe,
1068                )
1069                result["cosine"] = {
1070                    (spectrum_ids[i], spectrum_ids[j]): score
1071                    for (i, j), score in cosine_idx_scores.items()
1072                }
1073
1074        return result

Compute all-vs-all pairwise similarities using a provided FE library.

Canonical all-vs-all path: each spectrum is searched once against the FlashEntropy index (fe_lib_override or self.fe_lib), and upper-triangle pairwise scores are extracted from the result vectors.

Parameters
  • spectra (list): Spectrum objects with .mz_exp and .abundance attributes.

  • precursor_mzs (list of float or None, optional): Precursor m/z for each spectrum.
  • fe_lib_override (ms_entropy.FlashEntropySearch, optional): FlashEntropy library to search against. If None, falls back to self.fe_lib.
Returns
  • dict: {metric_name: {(id1, id2): score}}

  52        """Return FE library record dict for a library node ID, if available."""
  53        fe_lib = getattr(self, "fe_lib", None)
  54        if fe_lib is None:

  57        parse_idx = getattr(self, "library_index_from_node_id", None)
  58        if callable(parse_idx):

  60        else:

  63            except (TypeError, ValueError):

  67
  68        try:

  70        except (IndexError, KeyError, TypeError):

  72

  75    @staticmethod
  76    def _as_node_attr_value(value: Any) -> Any:
  77        """Convert values to JSON-friendly node attributes for Sigma hover panels."""
  78        if value is None or isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)):
  79            return value
  80        return str(value)

  82    def _resolve_library_label(
  83        self,
  84        node_id: str,
  85        record: dict[str, Any] | None,
  86        library_label_field: str | Sequence[str] | None,
  87    ) -> str:
  88        """Resolve display label for a library node from FE record fields."""
  89        fallback = node_id[:20] + "..." if len(node_id) > 20 else node_id
  90        if not record:
  91            return fallback
  92
  93        if library_label_field is None:
  94            candidate_fields: Sequence[str] = self._DEFAULT_LIBRARY_LABEL_FIELDS
  95        elif isinstance(library_label_field, str):
  96            candidate_fields = (library_label_field,)
  97        else:
  98            candidate_fields = library_label_field
  99
 100        for field in candidate_fields:
 101            value = record.get(field)
 102            if value is None:
 103                continue
 104            value_str = str(value).strip()
 105            if value_str:
 106                return value_str
 107
 108        return fallback
