 110    def _edges_to_dataframe(
 111        self,
 112        metric: str,
 113        score_threshold: float,
 114        include_queries_only: bool,
 115        exclude_self: bool,
 116    ) -> pd.DataFrame:
 117        """Return filtered edge list as a DataFrame with id1/id2/score."""
 118        mat = self.similarity_matrices[metric]
 119        all_edges = mat.get_pairs_above_threshold(0.0)
 120
 121        if not all_edges:
 122            return pd.DataFrame(columns=["id1", "id2", "score"])
 123
 124        edges = pd.DataFrame(all_edges, columns=["id1", "id2", "score"])
 125        edges = edges[edges["score"] >= score_threshold]
 126
 127        if exclude_self:
 128            edges = edges[edges["id1"] != edges["id2"]]
 129
 130        if include_queries_only and self._all_query_ids:
 131            query_id_set = set(self._all_query_ids)
 132
 133            # Keep all query edges plus library-library edges where both
 134            # library nodes are connected to at least one query node.
 135            q1 = edges["id1"].isin(query_id_set)
 136            q2 = edges["id2"].isin(query_id_set)
 137            ql_or_qq = q1 | q2
 138
 139            query_edges = edges[ql_or_qq]
 140            if query_edges.empty:
 141                return pd.DataFrame(columns=["id1", "id2", "score"])
 142
 143            lib_from_id1 = query_edges.loc[
 144                ~query_edges["id1"].isin(query_id_set), "id1"
 145            ]
 146            lib_from_id2 = query_edges.loc[
 147                ~query_edges["id2"].isin(query_id_set), "id2"
 148            ]
 149            query_connected_libs = set(pd.concat([lib_from_id1, lib_from_id2]).tolist())
 150
 151            ll_mask = (
 152                ~q1
 153                & ~q2
 154                & edges["id1"].isin(query_connected_libs)
 155                & edges["id2"].isin(query_connected_libs)
 156            )
 157
 158            edges = pd.concat(
 159                [query_edges, edges[ll_mask]], ignore_index=True
 160            ).drop_duplicates()
 161
 162        return edges
 163
 164    @staticmethod
 165    def _sparsify_top_k_edges(G, weight_attr: str, top_k: int):
 166        """Return an undirected top-k edge sparsified copy of *G*."""
 167        if top_k <= 0 or G.number_of_nodes() == 0:
 168            return G.copy()
 169
 170        H = G.to_undirected().copy()
 171        selected_edges: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
 172
 173        for node in H.nodes:
 174            neighbors = []
 175            for nbr in H.neighbors(node):
 176                edge_data = H.get_edge_data(node, nbr, default={})
 177                weight = float(edge_data.get(weight_attr, 1.0))
 178                neighbors.append((nbr, weight))
 179
 180            neighbors.sort(key=lambda t: (-t[1], str(t[0])))
 181            for nbr, _ in neighbors[:top_k]:
 182                edge_key = tuple(sorted((str(node), str(nbr))))
 183                selected_edges.add(edge_key)
 184
 185        S = H.__class__()
 186        S.add_nodes_from(H.nodes(data=True))
 187        for u, v, data in H.edges(data=True):
 188            edge_key = tuple(sorted((str(u), str(v))))
 189            if edge_key in selected_edges:
 190                S.add_edge(u, v, **data)
 191
 192        return S
 193
 194    def _detect_weighted_communities(
 195        self,
 196        G,
 197        *,
 198        weight_attr: str,
 199        super_threshold: int,
 200        sparsify_top_k: int,
 201        recursive_split: bool,
 202    ) -> list[set]:
 203        """Detect weighted communities with optional recursive splitting."""
 204        nx = _import_networkx()
 205
 206        def partition_graph(graph, depth: int = 0) -> list[set]:
 207            if graph.number_of_nodes() <= 1:
 208                return [set(graph.nodes)]
 209
 210            communities = list(
 211                nx.community.greedy_modularity_communities(
 212                    graph,
 213                    weight=weight_attr,
 214                )
 215            )
 216            if len(communities) <= 1:
 217                return [set(graph.nodes)]
 218
 219            sorted_communities = sorted(
 220                communities, key=lambda c: (-len(c), min(str(n) for n in c))
 221            )
 222            out: list[set] = []
 223
 224            for community in sorted_communities:
 225                community_set = set(community)
 226                if not recursive_split or len(community_set) <= super_threshold:
 227                    out.append(community_set)
 228                    continue
 229
 230                sub = graph.subgraph(community_set).copy()
 231                if sparsify_top_k > 0:
 232                    sub = self._sparsify_top_k_edges(
 233                        sub, weight_attr=weight_attr, top_k=sparsify_top_k
 234                    )
 235
 236                if sub.number_of_edges() == 0:
 237                    out.append(community_set)
 238                    continue
 239
 240                sub_parts = partition_graph(sub, depth + 1)
 241                if len(sub_parts) <= 1:
 242                    out.append(community_set)
 243                    continue
 244
 245                for part in sub_parts:
 246                    if part:
 247                        out.append(set(part))
 248
 249            return out
 250
 251        raw = partition_graph(G.to_undirected())
 252        normalized = [set(c) for c in raw if c]
 253        if not normalized:
 254            return [set(G.nodes)]
 255
 256        return sorted(normalized, key=lambda c: (-len(c), min(str(n) for n in c)))
 257
 258    @staticmethod
 259    def _compute_hierarchical_layout(
 260        G, communities: list[set], *, weight_attr: str, seed: int
 261    ):
 262        """Compute two-level (community + local) weighted spring layout."""
 263        nx = _import_networkx()
 264        if G.number_of_nodes() == 0:
 265            return {}
 266
 267        if not communities:
 268            pos = nx.spring_layout(
 269                G,
 270                seed=seed,
 271                weight=weight_attr,
 272                k=2.0 / max(G.number_of_nodes() ** 0.5, 1),
 273            )
 274            return {n: {"x": float(x), "y": float(y)} for n, (x, y) in pos.items()}
 275
 276        node_to_comm = {}
 277        for comm_idx, nodes in enumerate(communities):
 278            for node in nodes:
 279                node_to_comm[node] = comm_idx
 280
 281        meta = nx.Graph()
 282        for comm_idx, nodes in enumerate(communities):
 283            meta.add_node(comm_idx, size=len(nodes))
 284
 285        inter_weights: dict[tuple[int, int], float] = defaultdict(float)
 286        for u, v, data in G.edges(data=True):
 287            cu = node_to_comm.get(u)
 288            cv = node_to_comm.get(v)
 289            if cu is None or cv is None or cu == cv:
 290                continue
 291            edge = (cu, cv) if cu < cv else (cv, cu)
 292            inter_weights[edge] += float(data.get(weight_attr, 1.0))
 293
 294        for (cu, cv), w in inter_weights.items():
 295            meta.add_edge(cu, cv, weight=w)
 296
 297        # Build local layouts first to estimate community footprint radius.
 298        local_layouts: dict[int, dict] = {}
 299        community_radius: dict[int, float] = {}
 300        for comm_idx, nodes in enumerate(communities):
 301            sub = G.subgraph(nodes)
 302            if sub.number_of_nodes() == 1:
 303                only = next(iter(sub.nodes))
 304                local_pos = {only: (0.0, 0.0)}
 305            else:
 306                local_pos = nx.spring_layout(
 307                    sub,
 308                    seed=seed,
 309                    weight=weight_attr,
 310                    k=1.5 / max(sub.number_of_nodes() ** 0.5, 1),
 311                )
 312
 313            max_radius = 0.0
 314            for x, y in local_pos.values():
 315                max_radius = max(max_radius, float((x * x + y * y) ** 0.5))
 316            if max_radius <= 0:
 317                max_radius = 1.0
 318
 319            radius = 0.6 + 0.18 * (len(nodes) ** 0.5)
 320            local_layouts[comm_idx] = local_pos
 321            community_radius[comm_idx] = radius
 322
 323        if meta.number_of_nodes() == 1:
 324            meta_pos = {0: (0.0, 0.0)}
 325        else:
 326            # Larger k spreads community centers to reduce overlap.
 327            meta_pos = nx.spring_layout(
 328                meta,
 329                seed=seed,
 330                weight="weight",
 331                k=6.0 / max(meta.number_of_nodes() ** 0.5, 1),
 332            )
 333
 334        # Apply pairwise separation pass so center distances exceed
 335        # footprint-based minimum spacing.
 336        meta_xy = {idx: [float(x), float(y)] for idx, (x, y) in meta_pos.items()}
 337        comm_ids = list(meta_xy.keys())
 338        for _ in range(8):
 339            moved = False
 340            for i in range(len(comm_ids)):
 341                ci = comm_ids[i]
 342                xi, yi = meta_xy[ci]
 343                for j in range(i + 1, len(comm_ids)):
 344                    cj = comm_ids[j]
 345                    xj, yj = meta_xy[cj]
 346                    dx = xj - xi
 347                    dy = yj - yi
 348                    dist = (dx * dx + dy * dy) ** 0.5
 349                    min_dist = community_radius[ci] + community_radius[cj] + 0.8
 350                    if dist < min_dist:
 351                        moved = True
 352                        if dist <= 1e-9:
 353                            ux, uy = 1.0, 0.0
 354                        else:
 355                            ux, uy = dx / dist, dy / dist
 356                        push = 0.5 * (min_dist - max(dist, 1e-9))
 357                        meta_xy[ci][0] -= ux * push
 358                        meta_xy[ci][1] -= uy * push
 359                        meta_xy[cj][0] += ux * push
 360                        meta_xy[cj][1] += uy * push
 361            if not moved:
 362                break
 363
 364        final_pos: dict = {}
 365        for comm_idx, nodes in enumerate(communities):
 366            local_pos = local_layouts[comm_idx]
 367            max_radius = 0.0
 368            for x, y in local_pos.values():
 369                max_radius = max(max_radius, float((x * x + y * y) ** 0.5))
 370            if max_radius <= 0:
 371                max_radius = 1.0
 372
 373            cx, cy = meta_xy.get(comm_idx, [0.0, 0.0])
 374            radius = community_radius[comm_idx]
 375            for node, (x, y) in local_pos.items():
 376                final_pos[node] = {
 377                    "x": float(cx + radius * (x / max_radius)),
 378                    "y": float(cy + radius * (y / max_radius)),
 379                }
 380
 381        return final_pos
 382
 383    def _ensure_cluster_cache(self) -> dict[str, dict]:
 384        """Return mutable in-memory cluster-artifact cache.
 385
 386        The cache is keyed by metric name and stores artifacts generated by
 387        :meth:`compute_network_clusters` (tables, parameters, and layout).
 388        """
 389        if not hasattr(self, "_network_clusters"):
 390            self._network_clusters = {}
 391        return self._network_clusters
 392
 393    def _export_cluster_node_id(self, node_id: str, query_id_set: set[str]) -> str:
 394        """Return export-safe node ID for cluster file output.
 395
 396        Query IDs are preserved.  Library IDs are mapped through
 397        ``MolecularNetwork._export_node_id`` when present, so FlashEntropy
 398        internal indices can be exported as stable library identifiers (for
 399        example ``spectra_id``).
 400        """
 401        export_fn = getattr(self, "_export_node_id", None)
 402        if callable(export_fn):
 403            try:
 404                return str(export_fn(node_id, query_id_set))
 405            except (TypeError, ValueError, KeyError, IndexError):
 406                pass
 407        return str(node_id)
 408
 409    @staticmethod
 410    def _apply_query_connectivity_filters(
 411        G,
 412        *,
 413        nx,
 414        query_id_set: set,
 415        drop_components_without_queries: bool,
 416        drop_nodes_without_query_connection: bool,
 417    ) -> None:
 418        """Apply query-connectivity pruning in-place on graph ``G``.
 419
 420        Parameters
 421        ----------
 422        G
 423            NetworkX graph to mutate.
 424        nx
 425            Imported ``networkx`` module, passed in to avoid repeated imports.
 426        query_id_set : set
 427            Set of query node IDs.
 428        drop_components_without_queries : bool
 429            Drop connected components that contain no query nodes.
 430        drop_nodes_without_query_connection : bool
 431            Keep only query nodes and one-hop neighbors of query nodes.
 432        """
 433        if drop_components_without_queries and G.number_of_nodes() > 0:
 434            if G.is_directed():
 435                components = list(nx.weakly_connected_components(G))
 436            else:
 437                components = list(nx.connected_components(G))
 438
 439            nodes_to_remove = []
 440            for component in components:
 441                if component.isdisjoint(query_id_set):
 442                    nodes_to_remove.extend(component)
 443
 444            if nodes_to_remove:
 445                G.remove_nodes_from(nodes_to_remove)
 446
 447        if (
 448            drop_nodes_without_query_connection
 449            and G.number_of_nodes() > 0
 450            and query_id_set
 451        ):
 452            query_nodes_in_graph = [n for n in query_id_set if G.has_node(n)]
 453            if query_nodes_in_graph:
 454                keep_nodes = set(query_nodes_in_graph)
 455                for qnode in query_nodes_in_graph:
 456                    keep_nodes.update(G.neighbors(qnode))
 457
 458                if len(keep_nodes) < G.number_of_nodes():
 459                    nodes_to_remove = [n for n in G.nodes if n not in keep_nodes]
 460                    G.remove_nodes_from(nodes_to_remove)
 461
 462    def compute_network_clusters(
 463        self,
 464        metric: str = "entropy_similarity",
 465        *,
 466        include_queries_only: bool = True,
 467        score_threshold: float | None = None,
 468        max_edges: int | None = 500,
 469        max_nodes: int | None = None,
 470        exclude_self: bool = True,
 471        directed: bool = False,
 472        drop_components_without_queries: bool = True,
 473        drop_nodes_without_query_connection: bool = True,
 474        cluster_method: str = "weighted_greedy_modularity",
 475        cluster_weight_attr: str = "score",
 476        cluster_super_threshold: int = 400,
 477        cluster_sparsify_top_k: int = 8,
 478        cluster_recursive_split: bool = True,
 479        cluster_min_size: int = 2,
 480        compute_layout: bool = True,
 481        layout_seed: int = 42,
 482    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
 483        """Compute and cache clustering artifacts for one similarity metric.
 484
 485        This stage is separate from plotting.  It builds a graph from the
 486        selected similarity matrix, applies query-connectivity filters,
 487        computes communities, and stores node/community/edge/layout tables in
 488        an in-memory artifact cache for later plotting or export.
 489
 490        Parameters
 491        ----------
 492        metric : str
 493            Similarity metric key from ``self.similarity_matrices``.
 494        include_queries_only : bool
 495            Use query-focused edge filtering during edge extraction.
 496        score_threshold : float or None
 497            Minimum similarity score to include; ``None`` uses
 498            ``_threshold_for(metric)``.
 499        max_edges : int or None
 500            Keep top-N edges by score after filtering.
 501        max_nodes : int or None
 502            Keep edges whose endpoints are within highest-degree N nodes.
 503        exclude_self : bool
 504            Drop self-loop edges.
 505        directed : bool
 506            Build directed graph when ``True``.
 507        drop_components_without_queries : bool
 508            Remove connected components with no query nodes.
 509        drop_nodes_without_query_connection : bool
 510            Keep only query nodes and one-hop query neighbors.
 511        cluster_method : str
 512            Community method; currently ``"weighted_greedy_modularity"``.
 513        cluster_weight_attr : str
 514            Edge attribute used as clustering weight.
 515        cluster_super_threshold : int
 516            Threshold above which recursive splitting can apply.
 517        cluster_sparsify_top_k : int
 518            Top-k edge sparsification for oversized community refinement.
 519        cluster_recursive_split : bool
 520            Enable recursive refinement of oversized communities.
 521        cluster_min_size : int
 522            Reserved for future use; kept for API stability.
 523        compute_layout : bool
 524            Compute and cache hierarchical node coordinates.
 525        layout_seed : int
 526            Random seed for deterministic layout generation.
 527
 528        Returns
 529        -------
 530        dict
 531            Summary with ``metric``, ``n_nodes``, ``n_edges``, ``n_clusters``,
 532            and ``score_threshold``.
 533
 534        Raises
 535        ------
 536        KeyError
 537            If *metric* is unknown.
 538        ValueError
 539            If *cluster_method* is unsupported.
 540        """
 541        if metric not in self.similarity_matrices:
 542            raise KeyError(
 543                f"Unknown metric '{metric}'. Available: {list(self.similarity_matrices.keys())}"
 544            )
 545
 546        if cluster_method != "weighted_greedy_modularity":
 547            raise ValueError(
 548                "Unsupported cluster_method. "
 549                "Currently supported: ['weighted_greedy_modularity']"
 550            )
 551
 552        nx = _import_networkx()
 553
 554        if score_threshold is None:
 555            score_threshold = self._threshold_for(metric)
 556
 557        edges = self._edges_to_dataframe(
 558            metric=metric,
 559            score_threshold=score_threshold,
 560            include_queries_only=include_queries_only,
 561            exclude_self=exclude_self,
 562        )
 563
 564        if max_nodes is not None and not edges.empty:
 565            degree = (
 566                pd.concat([edges["id1"], edges["id2"]]).value_counts().head(max_nodes)
 567            )
 568            top_nodes = set(degree.index)
 569            edges = edges[edges["id1"].isin(top_nodes) & edges["id2"].isin(top_nodes)]
 570
 571        if max_edges is not None and not edges.empty:
 572            edges = edges.nlargest(max_edges, "score")
 573
 574        G = nx.DiGraph() if directed else nx.Graph()
 575        query_id_set = set(self._all_query_ids)
 576
 577        if not edges.empty:
 578            node_ids = (
 579                pd.concat([edges["id1"], edges["id2"]]).drop_duplicates().tolist()
 580            )
 581            for node_id in node_ids:
 582                G.add_node(
 583                    node_id,
 584                    node_type=("query" if node_id in query_id_set else "library"),
 585                )
 586            for row in edges.itertuples(index=False):
 587                G.add_edge(row.id1, row.id2, score=float(row.score))
 588
 589        self._apply_query_connectivity_filters(
 590            G,
 591            nx=nx,
 592            query_id_set=query_id_set,
 593            drop_components_without_queries=drop_components_without_queries,
 594            drop_nodes_without_query_connection=drop_nodes_without_query_connection,
 595        )
 596
 597        communities: list[set] = []
 598        if G.number_of_nodes() > 0:
 599            communities = self._detect_weighted_communities(
 600                G.to_undirected(),
 601                weight_attr=cluster_weight_attr,
 602                super_threshold=cluster_super_threshold,
 603                sparsify_top_k=cluster_sparsify_top_k,
 604                recursive_split=cluster_recursive_split,
 605            )
 606
 607        node_rows = []
 608        community_rows = []
 609        node_to_cluster: dict[str, str] = {}
 610
 611        for comm_idx, nodes in enumerate(communities):
 612            cluster_id = f"C{comm_idx:03d}"
 613            query_count = sum(1 for n in nodes if n in query_id_set)
 614            community_rows.append(
 615                {
 616                    "cluster_id": cluster_id,
 617                    "community_level": 0,
 618                    "size": len(nodes),
 619                    "query_count_in_community": query_count,
 620                }
 621            )
 622            for node in sorted(nodes, key=str):
 623                node_to_cluster[str(node)] = cluster_id
 624                node_rows.append(
 625                    {
 626                        "node_id": str(node),
 627                        "cluster_id": cluster_id,
 628                        "community_level": 0,
 629                        "community_size": len(nodes),
 630                        "query_count_in_community": query_count,
 631                        "node_type": G.nodes[node].get("node_type", "unknown"),
 632                    }
 633                )
 634
 635        # Ensure isolated nodes still receive a cluster assignment.
 636        if G.number_of_nodes() > 0:
 637            for node in G.nodes:
 638                node_s = str(node)
 639                if node_s in node_to_cluster:
 640                    continue
 641                cluster_id = f"C{len(community_rows):03d}"
 642                node_to_cluster[node_s] = cluster_id
 643                query_count = 1 if node in query_id_set else 0
 644                community_rows.append(
 645                    {
 646                        "cluster_id": cluster_id,
 647                        "community_level": 0,
 648                        "size": 1,
 649                        "query_count_in_community": query_count,
 650                    }
 651                )
 652                node_rows.append(
 653                    {
 654                        "node_id": node_s,
 655                        "cluster_id": cluster_id,
 656                        "community_level": 0,
 657                        "community_size": 1,
 658                        "query_count_in_community": query_count,
 659                        "node_type": G.nodes[node].get("node_type", "unknown"),
 660                    }
 661                )
 662
 663        edge_rows = []
 664        for u, v, data in G.edges(data=True):
 665            u_s = str(u)
 666            v_s = str(v)
 667            edge_rows.append(
 668                {
 669                    "id1": u_s,
 670                    "id2": v_s,
 671                    "score": float(data.get("score", 0.0)),
 672                    "cluster_id_1": node_to_cluster.get(u_s),
 673                    "cluster_id_2": node_to_cluster.get(v_s),
 674                    "intra_cluster": node_to_cluster.get(u_s)
 675                    == node_to_cluster.get(v_s),
 676                }
 677            )
 678
 679        layout_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["node_id", "x", "y"])
 680        if compute_layout and G.number_of_nodes() > 0:
 681            layout = self._compute_hierarchical_layout(
 682                G,
 683                communities,
 684                weight_attr=cluster_weight_attr,
 685                seed=layout_seed,
 686            )
 687            layout_df = pd.DataFrame(
 688                [
 689                    {"node_id": str(node_id), "x": coords["x"], "y": coords["y"]}
 690                    for node_id, coords in layout.items()
 691                ]
 692            )
 693
 694        artifact = {
 695            "metric": metric,
 696            "params": {
 697                "include_queries_only": include_queries_only,
 698                "score_threshold": score_threshold,
 699                "max_edges": max_edges,
 700                "max_nodes": max_nodes,
 701                "exclude_self": exclude_self,
 702                "directed": directed,
 703                "drop_components_without_queries": drop_components_without_queries,
 704                "drop_nodes_without_query_connection": drop_nodes_without_query_connection,
 705                "cluster_method": cluster_method,
 706                "cluster_weight_attr": cluster_weight_attr,
 707                "cluster_super_threshold": cluster_super_threshold,
 708                "cluster_sparsify_top_k": cluster_sparsify_top_k,
 709                "cluster_recursive_split": cluster_recursive_split,
 710                "cluster_min_size": cluster_min_size,
 711                "compute_layout": compute_layout,
 712                "layout_seed": layout_seed,
 713            },
 714            "node_table": pd.DataFrame(node_rows),
 715            "community_table": pd.DataFrame(community_rows),
 716            "edge_table": pd.DataFrame(edge_rows),
 717            "layout_table": layout_df,
 718            "schema_version": 1,
 719        }
 720
 721        self._ensure_cluster_cache()[metric] = artifact
 722
 723        return {
 724            "metric": metric,
 725            "n_nodes": G.number_of_nodes(),
 726            "n_edges": G.number_of_edges(),
 727            "n_clusters": int(artifact["community_table"].shape[0]),
 728            "score_threshold": float(score_threshold),
 729        }
 730
 731    def drop_network_clusters(self, metric: str | None = None) -> None:
 732        """Drop cached clustering artifacts while preserving similarity results.
 733
 734        Parameters
 735        ----------
 736        metric : str or None
 737            Metric cache key to remove.  When ``None``, clear all cached
 738            clustering artifacts.
 739        """
 740        cache = self._ensure_cluster_cache()
 741        if metric is None:
 742            cache.clear()
 743        else:
 744            cache.pop(metric, None)
 745
 746    def save_network_clusters(
 747        self, output_dir: str, metric: str, run_id: str | None = None
 748    ) -> dict[str, str]:
 749        """Persist computed cluster artifacts to CSV files.
 750
 751        Files written include node, community, edge, layout, and manifest CSVs.
 752        Library node IDs are exported using stable identifiers when available
 753        (for example ``spectra_id``) instead of internal index IDs.
 754
 755        Parameters
 756        ----------
 757        output_dir : str
 758            Output directory for CSV artifacts.
 759        metric : str
 760            Metric cache key to persist.
 761        run_id : str or None
 762            Optional suffix to disambiguate multiple runs.
 763
 764        Returns
 765        -------
 766        dict of str to str
 767            Paths for ``nodes``, ``communities``, ``edges``, ``layout``,
 768            and ``manifest`` files.
 769
 770        Raises
 771        ------
 772        RuntimeError
 773            If no cached clusters exist for *metric*.
 774        """
 775        cache = self._ensure_cluster_cache()
 776        artifact = cache.get(metric)
 777        if artifact is None:
 778            raise RuntimeError(
 779                f"No clusters available for metric '{metric}'. Call compute_network_clusters(...) first."
 780            )
 781
 782        out_dir = Path(output_dir)
 783        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 784
 785        suffix = f"_{run_id}" if run_id else ""
 786        prefix = f"{metric}_clusters{suffix}"
 787
 788        node_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_nodes.csv"
 789        community_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_communities.csv"
 790        edge_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_edges.csv"
 791        manifest_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_manifest.csv"
 792        layout_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_layout.csv"
 793
 794        query_id_set = set(getattr(self, "_all_query_ids", []) or [])
 795
 796        node_export_df = artifact["node_table"].copy()
 797        if "node_id" in node_export_df.columns:
 798            node_export_df["node_id"] = (
 799                node_export_df["node_id"]
 800                .astype(str)
 801                .map(
 802                    lambda node_id: self._export_cluster_node_id(node_id, query_id_set)
 803                )
 804            )
 805
 806        edge_export_df = artifact["edge_table"].copy()
 807        if "id1" in edge_export_df.columns:
 808            edge_export_df["id1"] = (
 809                edge_export_df["id1"]
 810                .astype(str)
 811                .map(
 812                    lambda node_id: self._export_cluster_node_id(node_id, query_id_set)
 813                )
 814            )
 815        if "id2" in edge_export_df.columns:
 816            edge_export_df["id2"] = (
 817                edge_export_df["id2"]
 818                .astype(str)
 819                .map(
 820                    lambda node_id: self._export_cluster_node_id(node_id, query_id_set)
 821                )
 822            )
 823
 824        layout_export_df = artifact["layout_table"].copy()
 825        if "node_id" in layout_export_df.columns:
 826            layout_export_df["node_id"] = (
 827                layout_export_df["node_id"]
 828                .astype(str)
 829                .map(
 830                    lambda node_id: self._export_cluster_node_id(node_id, query_id_set)
 831                )
 832            )
 833
 834        node_export_df.to_csv(node_path, index=False)
 835        artifact["community_table"].to_csv(community_path, index=False)
 836        edge_export_df.to_csv(edge_path, index=False)
 837        layout_export_df.to_csv(layout_path, index=False)
 838
 839        pd.DataFrame(
 840            [
 841                {
 842                    "schema_version": artifact.get("schema_version", 1),
 843                    "metric": metric,
 844                    "run_id": run_id or "",
 845                    "params_json": json.dumps(
 846                        artifact.get("params", {}), sort_keys=True
 847                    ),
 848                }
 849            ]
 850        ).to_csv(manifest_path, index=False)
 851
 852        return {
 853            "nodes": str(node_path),
 854            "communities": str(community_path),
 855            "edges": str(edge_path),
 856            "layout": str(layout_path),
 857            "manifest": str(manifest_path),
 858        }
 859
 860    def load_network_clusters(
 861        self, output_dir: str, metric: str, run_id: str | None = None
 862    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
 863        """Load cluster artifacts from CSV files into in-memory cache.
 864
 865        Parameters
 866        ----------
 867        output_dir : str
 868            Directory containing saved cluster CSV artifacts.
 869        metric : str
 870            Metric key to load.
 871        run_id : str or None
 872            Optional run suffix used when saving.
 873
 874        Returns
 875        -------
 876        dict
 877            Summary with ``metric``, ``n_nodes``, ``n_edges``, and
 878            ``n_clusters``.
 879
 880        Raises
 881        ------
 882        FileNotFoundError
 883            If required artifact files are missing.
 884        """
 885        out_dir = Path(output_dir)
 886        suffix = f"_{run_id}" if run_id else ""
 887        prefix = f"{metric}_clusters{suffix}"
 888
 889        node_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_nodes.csv"
 890        community_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_communities.csv"
 891        edge_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_edges.csv"
 892        manifest_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_manifest.csv"
 893        layout_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_layout.csv"
 894
 895        if (
 896            not node_path.exists()
 897            or not community_path.exists()
 898            or not edge_path.exists()
 899        ):
 900            raise FileNotFoundError(
 901                f"Missing cluster artifact files for metric '{metric}' in '{output_dir}'."
 902            )
 903
 904        params = {}
 905        schema_version = 1
 906        if manifest_path.exists():
 907            mdf = pd.read_csv(manifest_path)
 908            if not mdf.empty:
 909                schema_version = int(mdf.iloc[0].get("schema_version", 1))
 910                params_json = mdf.iloc[0].get("params_json", "{}")
 911                try:
 912                    params = (
 913                        json.loads(params_json) if isinstance(params_json, str) else {}
 914                    )
 915                except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError):
 916                    params = {}
 917
 918        artifact = {
 919            "metric": metric,
 920            "params": params,
 921            "schema_version": schema_version,
 922            "node_table": pd.read_csv(node_path),
 923            "community_table": pd.read_csv(community_path),
 924            "edge_table": pd.read_csv(edge_path),
 925            "layout_table": pd.read_csv(layout_path)
 926            if layout_path.exists()
 927            else pd.DataFrame(columns=["node_id", "x", "y"]),
 928        }
 929
 930        self._ensure_cluster_cache()[metric] = artifact
 931        return {
 932            "metric": metric,
 933            "n_nodes": int(artifact["node_table"].shape[0]),
 934            "n_edges": int(artifact["edge_table"].shape[0]),
 935            "n_clusters": int(artifact["community_table"].shape[0]),
 936        }
 937
 938    def _build_networkx_graph(
 939        self,
 940        metric: str = "entropy_similarity",
 941        *,
 942        include_queries_only: bool = True,
 943        score_threshold: float | None = None,
 944        max_edges: int | None = 500,
 945        max_nodes: int | None = None,
 946        exclude_self: bool = True,
 947        directed: bool = False,
 948        color_map: dict[str, str] | None = None,
 949        metadata: dict[str, dict] | None = None,
 950        library_label_field: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
 951        library_node_attrs: Sequence[str] | None = None,
 952        drop_components_without_queries: bool = True,
 953        drop_nodes_without_query_connection: bool = True,
 954        layout_seed: int = 42,
 955        bypass_clustering: bool = True,
 956        separate_communities: bool = True,
 957    ) -> tuple[Any, dict | None, dict[str, str], float]:
 958        """Build a NetworkX graph + layout for static or interactive plotting.
 959
 960        Returns
 961        -------
 962        G : networkx.Graph
 963            Graph with node attrs ``label``, ``node_type``, optional community
 964            and viz styling fields, and edge attr ``score``.
 965        layout : dict or None
 966            Mapping ``node_id → {"x": float, "y": float}`` for drawing.
 967        palette : dict
 968            Color map for ``node_type`` values (query / library / unknown).
 969        score_threshold : float
 970            Effective score threshold used for edges.
 971        """
 972        if metric not in self.similarity_matrices:
 973            raise KeyError(
 974                f"Unknown metric '{metric}'. Available: {list(self.similarity_matrices.keys())}"
 975            )
 976
 977        nx = _import_networkx()
 978
 979        cache = self._ensure_cluster_cache()
 980        artifact = cache.get(metric)
 981        if not bypass_clustering and artifact is None:
 982            raise RuntimeError(
 983                f"No clusters available for metric '{metric}'. "
 984                "Call compute_network_clusters(...) first, or set bypass_clustering=True."
 985            )
 986
 987        if score_threshold is None:
 988            score_threshold = self._threshold_for(metric)
 989
 990        if bypass_clustering:
 991            edges = self._edges_to_dataframe(
 992                metric=metric,
 993                score_threshold=score_threshold,
 994                include_queries_only=include_queries_only,
 995                exclude_self=exclude_self,
 996            )
 997        else:
 998            edges = artifact["edge_table"][["id1", "id2", "score"]].copy()
 999            edges = edges[edges["score"] >= score_threshold]
1000
1001        if max_nodes is not None and not edges.empty:
1002            degree = (
1003                pd.concat([edges["id1"], edges["id2"]]).value_counts().head(max_nodes)
1004            )
1005            top_nodes = set(degree.index)
1006            edges = edges[edges["id1"].isin(top_nodes) & edges["id2"].isin(top_nodes)]
1007
1008        if max_edges is not None and not edges.empty:
1009            edges = edges.nlargest(max_edges, "score")
1010
1011        G = nx.DiGraph() if directed else nx.Graph()
1012
1013        palette = dict(self._DEFAULT_COLOR_MAP)
1014        if color_map:
1015            palette.update(color_map)
1016
1017        query_id_set = set(self._all_query_ids)
1018
1019        if not edges.empty:
1020            node_ids = (
1021                pd.concat([edges["id1"], edges["id2"]]).drop_duplicates().tolist()
1022            )
1023
1024            for node_id in node_ids:
1025                node_kind = "query" if node_id in query_id_set else "library"
1026                lib_record = (
1027                    self._library_record_for_node(node_id)
1028                    if node_kind == "library"
1029                    else None
1030                )
1031
1032                label = (
1033                    self._resolve_library_label(
1034                        node_id=node_id,
1035                        record=lib_record,
1036                        library_label_field=library_label_field,
1037                    )
1038                    if node_kind == "library"
1039                    else (node_id[:20] + "..." if len(node_id) > 20 else node_id)
1040                )
1041
1042                attrs: dict = {
1043                    "label": label,
1044                    "node_type": node_kind,
1045                }
1046
1047                if node_kind == "library" and lib_record and library_node_attrs:
1048                    for field in library_node_attrs:
1049                        if field in lib_record:
1050                            attrs[field] = self._as_node_attr_value(
1051                                lib_record.get(field)
1052                            )
1053
1054                if metadata:
1055                    attrs.update(metadata.get(node_id, {}))
1056
1057                G.add_node(node_id, **attrs)
1058
1059            for row in edges.itertuples(index=False):
1060                G.add_edge(row.id1, row.id2, score=float(row.score))
1061
1062        if bypass_clustering:
1063            self._apply_query_connectivity_filters(
1064                G,
1065                nx=nx,
1066                query_id_set=query_id_set,
1067                drop_components_without_queries=drop_components_without_queries,
1068                drop_nodes_without_query_connection=drop_nodes_without_query_connection,
1069            )
1070
1071        # Default node styling (shared by static and interactive plots)
1072        for node in G.nodes:
1073            node_type = G.nodes[node].get("node_type", "unknown")
1074            if node_type == "query":
1075                G.nodes[node]["viz_size"] = 2
1076                G.nodes[node]["viz_border_color"] = "#000000"
1077                G.nodes[node]["viz_border_size"] = 3
1078            else:
1079                G.nodes[node]["viz_size"] = 1
1080                G.nodes[node]["viz_border_color"] = "#00000000"
1081                G.nodes[node]["viz_border_size"] = 0
1082
1083        community_groups: list[set] = []
1084        if (
1085            not bypass_clustering
1086            and artifact is not None
1087            and not artifact["node_table"].empty
1088        ):
1089            node_table = artifact["node_table"].set_index("node_id")
1090            for node in list(G.nodes):
1091                node_s = str(node)
1092                if node_s not in node_table.index:
1093                    continue
1094                row = node_table.loc[node_s]
1095                G.nodes[node]["community_id"] = row.get("cluster_id")
1096                G.nodes[node]["community_level"] = int(row.get("community_level", 0))
1097                G.nodes[node]["community_size"] = int(row.get("community_size", 1))
1098                G.nodes[node]["query_count_in_community"] = int(
1099                    row.get("query_count_in_community", 0)
1100                )
1101
1102            by_cluster = node_table.reset_index().groupby("cluster_id")["node_id"]
1103            community_groups = [set(group.tolist()) for _, group in by_cluster]
1104
1105            if separate_communities:
1106                inter_edges = []
1107                for u, v in G.edges():
1108                    cu = G.nodes[u].get("community_id")
1109                    cv = G.nodes[v].get("community_id")
1110                    if cu is not None and cv is not None and cu != cv:
1111                        inter_edges.append((u, v))
1112                if inter_edges:
1113                    G.remove_edges_from(inter_edges)
1114
1115        layout: dict | None = None
1116        if G.number_of_nodes() > 0:
1117            if (
1118                not bypass_clustering
1119                and artifact is not None
1120                and not separate_communities
1121                and not artifact["layout_table"].empty
1122            ):
1123                layout = {
1124                    str(row.node_id): {"x": float(row.x), "y": float(row.y)}
1125                    for row in artifact["layout_table"].itertuples(index=False)
1126                    if G.has_node(str(row.node_id))
1127                }
1128                if len(layout) != G.number_of_nodes():
1129                    pos = nx.spring_layout(
1130                        G,
1131                        seed=layout_seed,
1132                        weight="score",
1133                        k=2.0 / max(G.number_of_nodes() ** 0.5, 1),
1134                    )
1135                    for node, (x, y) in pos.items():
1136                        layout.setdefault(str(node), {"x": float(x), "y": float(y)})
1137            elif not bypass_clustering and artifact is not None and community_groups:
1138                present_groups = []
1139                for group in community_groups:
1140                    nodes_present = {n for n in group if G.has_node(n)}
1141                    if nodes_present:
1142                        present_groups.append(nodes_present)
1143                layout = self._compute_hierarchical_layout(
1144                    G,
1145                    present_groups,
1146                    weight_attr="score",
1147                    seed=layout_seed,
1148                )
1149            else:
1150                pos = nx.spring_layout(
1151                    G,
1152                    seed=layout_seed,
1153                    weight="score",
1154                    k=2.0 / max(G.number_of_nodes() ** 0.5, 1),
1155                )
1156                layout = {
1157                    str(n): {"x": float(x), "y": float(y)} for n, (x, y) in pos.items()
1158                }
1159
1160        return G, layout, palette, float(score_threshold)
1161
1162    def plot_network(
1163        self,
1164        metric: str = "entropy_similarity",
1165        *,
1166        ax=None,
1167        path: str | None = None,
1168        return_fig: bool = False,
1169        include_queries_only: bool = True,
1170        score_threshold: float | None = None,
1171        max_edges: int | None = 500,
1172        max_nodes: int | None = None,
1173        exclude_self: bool = True,
1174        drop_components_without_queries: bool = True,
1175        drop_nodes_without_query_connection: bool = True,
1176        layout_seed: int = 42,
1177        bypass_clustering: bool = True,
1178        separate_communities: bool = True,
1179        color_map: dict[str, str] | None = None,
1180        library_label_field: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
1181        show_labels: bool = True,
1182        label_max_nodes: int = 40,
1183        node_size_query: float = 90,
1184        node_size_library: float = 55,
1185        figsize: tuple[float, float] = (9, 7),
1186        title: str | None = None,
1187        dpi: int = 150,
1188    ):
1189        """Draw a static matplotlib snapshot of the molecular network.
1190
1191        Portable for Jupyter notebooks rendered on GitLab/GitHub (PNG output).
1192        For interactive HTML exploration, use :meth:`plot_interactive_network`
1193        (requires ``ipysigma`` / ``corems[networking]``).
1194
1195        Parameters
1196        ----------
1197        metric : str
1198            Similarity metric key. Default ``"entropy_similarity"``.
1199        ax : matplotlib.axes.Axes, optional
1200            Axes to draw on. If None, a new figure is created.
1201        path : str, optional
1202            If set, save the figure to this path (``savefig``).
1203        return_fig : bool
1204            If True, return the ``Figure`` and do not call ``plt.show()``.
1205            Default False.
1206        include_queries_only, score_threshold, max_edges, max_nodes, …
1207            Edge/node filtering and layout options (see
1208            :meth:`plot_interactive_network`).
1209        bypass_clustering : bool
1210            If True (default), plot the raw filtered graph without requiring
1211            precomputed clusters.
1212        show_labels : bool
1213            Draw node labels (capped by *label_max_nodes*). Default True.
1214        label_max_nodes : int
1215            Maximum number of labels to draw (highest-degree nodes). Default 40.
1216        node_size_query, node_size_library : float
1217            Matplotlib scatter sizes for query vs library nodes.
1218        figsize : tuple of float
1219            Figure size when *ax* is None. Default ``(9, 7)``.
1220        title : str, optional
1221            Axes title. Default summarizes metric, threshold, and edge count.
1222        dpi : int
1223            DPI used when saving *path*. Default 150.
1224
1225        Returns
1226        -------
1227        matplotlib.figure.Figure or None
1228            The figure if *return_fig* is True, otherwise None.
1229        """
1230        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
1231        from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
1232
1233        G, layout, palette, thr = self._build_networkx_graph(
1234            metric=metric,
1235            include_queries_only=include_queries_only,
1236            score_threshold=score_threshold,
1237            max_edges=max_edges,
1238            max_nodes=max_nodes,
1239            exclude_self=exclude_self,
1240            directed=False,
1241            color_map=color_map,
1242            library_label_field=library_label_field,
1243            drop_components_without_queries=drop_components_without_queries,
1244            drop_nodes_without_query_connection=drop_nodes_without_query_connection,
1245            layout_seed=layout_seed,
1246            bypass_clustering=bypass_clustering,
1247            separate_communities=separate_communities,
1248        )
1249
1250        if ax is None:
1251            fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
1252        else:
1253            fig = ax.figure
1254
1255        if layout is None or G.number_of_nodes() == 0:
1256            ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No network edges to plot", ha="center", va="center")
1257            ax.set_axis_off()
1258        else:
1259            pos = {
1260                n: (float(layout[str(n)]["x"]), float(layout[str(n)]["y"]))
1261                for n in G.nodes
1262                if str(n) in layout
1263            }
1264            # Fallback positions for any missing layout keys
1265            for n in G.nodes:
1266                if n not in pos:
1267                    pos[n] = (0.0, 0.0)
1268
1269            scores = [float(d.get("score", 0.0)) for _, _, d in G.edges(data=True)]
1270            smin = min(scores) if scores else 0.0
1271            smax = max(scores) if scores else 1.0
1272            span = (smax - smin) + 1e-12
1273
1274            for u, v, data in G.edges(data=True):
1275                x0, y0 = pos[u]
1276                x1, y1 = pos[v]
1277                score = float(data.get("score", 0.0))
1278                lw = 0.5 + 2.5 * ((score - smin) / span)
1279                ax.plot([x0, x1], [y0, y1], color="0.65", lw=lw, zorder=1, alpha=0.85)
1280
1281            for n, (x, y) in pos.items():
1282                is_query = G.nodes[n].get("node_type") == "query"
1283                ax.scatter(
1284                    [x],
1285                    [y],
1286                    s=node_size_query if is_query else node_size_library,
1287                    c=palette.get("query" if is_query else "library", "#95a5a6"),
1288                    edgecolors="white",
1289                    linewidths=0.6,
1290                    zorder=2,
1291                )
1292
1293            if show_labels and G.number_of_nodes() > 0:
1294                degrees = dict(G.degree())
1295                label_nodes = sorted(degrees, key=lambda n: (-degrees[n], str(n)))[
1296                    : max(0, int(label_max_nodes))
1297                ]
1298                for n in label_nodes:
1299                    x, y = pos[n]
1300                    label = str(G.nodes[n].get("label", n))
1301                    if len(label) > 18:
1302                        label = label[:15] + "…"
1303                    ax.text(x, y, label, fontsize=7, ha="center", va="bottom", zorder=3)
1304
1305            legend = [
1306                Line2D(
1307                    [0],
1308                    [0],
1309                    marker="o",
1310                    color="w",
1311                    markerfacecolor=palette.get("query", "#e74c3c"),
1312                    markersize=9,
1313                    label="Experimental MS2 (query)",
1314                ),
1315                Line2D(
1316                    [0],
1317                    [0],
1318                    marker="o",
1319                    color="w",
1320                    markerfacecolor=palette.get("library", "#3498db"),
1321                    markersize=8,
1322                    label="Library spectrum",
1323                ),
1324            ]
1325            ax.legend(handles=legend, loc="best", frameon=True)
1326            ax.set_axis_off()
1327
1328        if title is None:
1329            title = (
1330                f"Molecular network ({metric}, threshold={thr:g}, "
1331                f"{G.number_of_edges()} edges)"
1332            )
1333        ax.set_title(title)
1334        fig.tight_layout()
1335
1336        if path is not None:
1337            fig.savefig(path, dpi=dpi, bbox_inches="tight")
1338
1339        if return_fig:
1340            return fig
1341
1342        # Prefer IPython Image display so notebooks capture PNG under Agg / headless CI
1343        try:
1344            import io
1345
1346            from IPython import get_ipython
1347            from IPython.display import Image, display
1348
1349            if get_ipython() is not None:
1350                buf = io.BytesIO()
1351                fig.savefig(buf, format="png", dpi=dpi, bbox_inches="tight")
1352                display(Image(data=buf.getvalue()))
1353                plt.close(fig)
1354                return None
1355        except ImportError:
1356            pass
1357
1358        plt.show()
1359        return None
1360
1361    def plot_interactive_network(
1362        self,
1363        metric: str = "entropy_similarity",
1364        out_path: str = "network.html",
1365        *,
1366        include_queries_only: bool = True,
1367        score_threshold: float | None = None,
1368        max_edges: int | None = 500,
1369        max_nodes: int | None = None,
1370        exclude_self: bool = True,
1371        directed: bool = False,
1372        color_map: dict[str, str] | None = None,
1373        sigma_options: dict | None = None,
1374        metadata: dict[str, dict] | None = None,
1375        library_label_field: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
1376        library_node_attrs: Sequence[str] | None = None,
1377        drop_components_without_queries: bool = True,
1378        drop_nodes_without_query_connection: bool = True,
1379        layout_seed: int = 42,
1380        bypass_clustering: bool = False,
1381        separate_communities: bool = True,
1382        display_in_notebook: bool = False,
1383        iframe_height: int = 650,
1384    ) -> str:
1385        """Write an interactive ipysigma HTML network visualization.
1386
1387        Prefer :meth:`plot_network` for static snapshots that render on
1388        GitLab/GitHub notebook previews. This method requires **ipysigma**
1389        (``pip install "corems[networking]"``).
1390
1391        Parameters
1392        ----------
1393        out_path : str
1394            Output HTML file path.
1395        separate_communities : bool
1396            When plotting from precomputed clusters (``bypass_clustering=False``),
1397            remove inter-community edges so each community renders as a separate
1398            subnetwork.  Default ``True``.
1399        display_in_notebook : bool
1400            If ``True``, also embed the HTML in a local Jupyter frontend via a
1401            data-URI iframe.  Does **not** render on GitLab/GitHub notebook
1402            previews.  Default ``False``.
1403        iframe_height : int
1404            Pixel height of the notebook iframe when *display_in_notebook* is
1405            True.  Default ``650``.
1406
1407        Returns
1408        -------
1409        str
1410            Path to the written HTML file.
1411        """
1412        try:
1413            from ipysigma import Sigma
1414        except ImportError as exc:
1415            raise ImportError(
1416                "ipysigma is required for plot_interactive_network(). "
1417                'Install with: pip install "corems[networking]" '
1418                "(or: pip install ipysigma)"
1419            ) from exc
1420
1421        G, layout, palette, _thr = self._build_networkx_graph(
1422            metric=metric,
1423            include_queries_only=include_queries_only,
1424            score_threshold=score_threshold,
1425            max_edges=max_edges,
1426            max_nodes=max_nodes,
1427            exclude_self=exclude_self,
1428            directed=directed,
1429            color_map=color_map,
1430            metadata=metadata,
1431            library_label_field=library_label_field,
1432            library_node_attrs=library_node_attrs,
1433            drop_components_without_queries=drop_components_without_queries,
1434            drop_nodes_without_query_connection=drop_nodes_without_query_connection,
1435            layout_seed=layout_seed,
1436            bypass_clustering=bypass_clustering,
1437            separate_communities=separate_communities,
1438        )
1439
1440        cache = self._ensure_cluster_cache()
1441        artifact = cache.get(metric)
1442        clustered_mode = (
1443            not bypass_clustering and artifact is not None and G.number_of_nodes() > 0
1444        )
1445        write_kwargs: dict = {
1446            "layout": layout,
1447            "node_color": "community_id" if clustered_mode else "node_type",
1448            "node_size": "viz_size",
1449            "node_size_range": (8, 18),
1450            "node_border_color": "viz_border_color",
1451            "node_border_size": "viz_border_size",
1452            "node_border_size_range": (0, 4),
1453            "default_edge_type": "line",
1454            "default_edge_color": "#aaa",
1455            "fullscreen": True,
1456        }
1457        if not clustered_mode:
1458            write_kwargs["node_color_palette"] = palette
1459        if sigma_options:
1460            write_kwargs.update(sigma_options)
1461
1462        out = Path(out_path)
1463        out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1464        Sigma.write_html(G, str(out), **write_kwargs)
1465
1466        if display_in_notebook:
1467            self._display_network_html_in_notebook(out, height=iframe_height)
1468
1469        return str(out)
1470
1471    @staticmethod
1472    def _display_network_html_in_notebook(
1473        html_path: Path, *, height: int = 650
1474    ) -> None:
1475        """Embed a written Sigma HTML file in a Jupyter notebook output cell.
1476
1477        Uses a base64 data-URI iframe so the notebook remains portable (no
1478        machine-local ``file://`` paths).  No-ops if IPython is unavailable.
1479        Note: GitLab/GitHub notebook previews do not execute this iframe.
1480        """
1481        try:
1482            from base64 import b64encode
1483
1484            from IPython.display import IFrame, display
1485        except ImportError:
1486            return
1487
1488        html_bytes = Path(html_path).read_bytes()
1489        html_b64 = b64encode(html_bytes).decode("ascii")
1490        display(
1491            IFrame(
1492                src=f"data:text/html;base64,{html_b64}",
1493                width="100%",
1494                height=int(height),
1495            )
1496        )

Mixin that adds static and interactive network plotting.

def compute_network_clusters( self, metric: str = 'entropy_similarity', *, include_queries_only: bool = True, score_threshold: float | None = None, max_edges: int | None = 500, max_nodes: int | None = None, exclude_self: bool = True, directed: bool = False, drop_components_without_queries: bool = True, drop_nodes_without_query_connection: bool = True, cluster_method: str = 'weighted_greedy_modularity', cluster_weight_attr: str = 'score', cluster_super_threshold: int = 400, cluster_sparsify_top_k: int = 8, cluster_recursive_split: bool = True, cluster_min_size: int = 2, compute_layout: bool = True, layout_seed: int = 42) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
462    def compute_network_clusters(
463        self,
464        metric: str = "entropy_similarity",
465        *,
466        include_queries_only: bool = True,
467        score_threshold: float | None = None,
468        max_edges: int | None = 500,
469        max_nodes: int | None = None,
470        exclude_self: bool = True,
471        directed: bool = False,
472        drop_components_without_queries: bool = True,
473        drop_nodes_without_query_connection: bool = True,
474        cluster_method: str = "weighted_greedy_modularity",
475        cluster_weight_attr: str = "score",
476        cluster_super_threshold: int = 400,
477        cluster_sparsify_top_k: int = 8,
478        cluster_recursive_split: bool = True,
479        cluster_min_size: int = 2,
480        compute_layout: bool = True,
481        layout_seed: int = 42,
482    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
483        """Compute and cache clustering artifacts for one similarity metric.
484
485        This stage is separate from plotting.  It builds a graph from the
486        selected similarity matrix, applies query-connectivity filters,
487        computes communities, and stores node/community/edge/layout tables in
488        an in-memory artifact cache for later plotting or export.
489
490        Parameters
491        ----------
492        metric : str
493            Similarity metric key from ``self.similarity_matrices``.
494        include_queries_only : bool
495            Use query-focused edge filtering during edge extraction.
496        score_threshold : float or None
497            Minimum similarity score to include; ``None`` uses
498            ``_threshold_for(metric)``.
499        max_edges : int or None
500            Keep top-N edges by score after filtering.
501        max_nodes : int or None
502            Keep edges whose endpoints are within highest-degree N nodes.
503        exclude_self : bool
504            Drop self-loop edges.
505        directed : bool
506            Build directed graph when ``True``.
507        drop_components_without_queries : bool
508            Remove connected components with no query nodes.
509        drop_nodes_without_query_connection : bool
510            Keep only query nodes and one-hop query neighbors.
511        cluster_method : str
512            Community method; currently ``"weighted_greedy_modularity"``.
513        cluster_weight_attr : str
514            Edge attribute used as clustering weight.
515        cluster_super_threshold : int
516            Threshold above which recursive splitting can apply.
517        cluster_sparsify_top_k : int
518            Top-k edge sparsification for oversized community refinement.
519        cluster_recursive_split : bool
520            Enable recursive refinement of oversized communities.
521        cluster_min_size : int
522            Reserved for future use; kept for API stability.
523        compute_layout : bool
524            Compute and cache hierarchical node coordinates.
525        layout_seed : int
526            Random seed for deterministic layout generation.
527
528        Returns
529        -------
530        dict
531            Summary with ``metric``, ``n_nodes``, ``n_edges``, ``n_clusters``,
532            and ``score_threshold``.
533
534        Raises
535        ------
536        KeyError
537            If *metric* is unknown.
538        ValueError
539            If *cluster_method* is unsupported.
540        """
541        if metric not in self.similarity_matrices:
542            raise KeyError(
543                f"Unknown metric '{metric}'. Available: {list(self.similarity_matrices.keys())}"
544            )
545
546        if cluster_method != "weighted_greedy_modularity":
547            raise ValueError(
548                "Unsupported cluster_method. "
549                "Currently supported: ['weighted_greedy_modularity']"
550            )
551
552        nx = _import_networkx()
553
554        if score_threshold is None:
555            score_threshold = self._threshold_for(metric)
556
557        edges = self._edges_to_dataframe(
558            metric=metric,
559            score_threshold=score_threshold,
560            include_queries_only=include_queries_only,
561            exclude_self=exclude_self,
562        )
563
564        if max_nodes is not None and not edges.empty:
565            degree = (
566                pd.concat([edges["id1"], edges["id2"]]).value_counts().head(max_nodes)
567            )
568            top_nodes = set(degree.index)
569            edges = edges[edges["id1"].isin(top_nodes) & edges["id2"].isin(top_nodes)]
570
571        if max_edges is not None and not edges.empty:
572            edges = edges.nlargest(max_edges, "score")
573
574        G = nx.DiGraph() if directed else nx.Graph()
575        query_id_set = set(self._all_query_ids)
576
577        if not edges.empty:
578            node_ids = (
579                pd.concat([edges["id1"], edges["id2"]]).drop_duplicates().tolist()
580            )
581            for node_id in node_ids:
582                G.add_node(
583                    node_id,
584                    node_type=("query" if node_id in query_id_set else "library"),
585                )
586            for row in edges.itertuples(index=False):
587                G.add_edge(row.id1, row.id2, score=float(row.score))
588
589        self._apply_query_connectivity_filters(
590            G,
591            nx=nx,
592            query_id_set=query_id_set,
593            drop_components_without_queries=drop_components_without_queries,
594            drop_nodes_without_query_connection=drop_nodes_without_query_connection,
595        )
596
597        communities: list[set] = []
598        if G.number_of_nodes() > 0:
599            communities = self._detect_weighted_communities(
600                G.to_undirected(),
601                weight_attr=cluster_weight_attr,
602                super_threshold=cluster_super_threshold,
603                sparsify_top_k=cluster_sparsify_top_k,
604                recursive_split=cluster_recursive_split,
605            )
606
607        node_rows = []
608        community_rows = []
609        node_to_cluster: dict[str, str] = {}
610
611        for comm_idx, nodes in enumerate(communities):
612            cluster_id = f"C{comm_idx:03d}"
613            query_count = sum(1 for n in nodes if n in query_id_set)
614            community_rows.append(
615                {
616                    "cluster_id": cluster_id,
617                    "community_level": 0,
618                    "size": len(nodes),
619                    "query_count_in_community": query_count,
620                }
621            )
622            for node in sorted(nodes, key=str):
623                node_to_cluster[str(node)] = cluster_id
624                node_rows.append(
625                    {
626                        "node_id": str(node),
627                        "cluster_id": cluster_id,
628                        "community_level": 0,
629                        "community_size": len(nodes),
630                        "query_count_in_community": query_count,
631                        "node_type": G.nodes[node].get("node_type", "unknown"),
632                    }
633                )
634
635        # Ensure isolated nodes still receive a cluster assignment.
636        if G.number_of_nodes() > 0:
637            for node in G.nodes:
638                node_s = str(node)
639                if node_s in node_to_cluster:
640                    continue
641                cluster_id = f"C{len(community_rows):03d}"
642                node_to_cluster[node_s] = cluster_id
643                query_count = 1 if node in query_id_set else 0
644                community_rows.append(
645                    {
646                        "cluster_id": cluster_id,
647                        "community_level": 0,
648                        "size": 1,
649                        "query_count_in_community": query_count,
650                    }
651                )
652                node_rows.append(
653                    {
654                        "node_id": node_s,
655                        "cluster_id": cluster_id,
656                        "community_level": 0,
657                        "community_size": 1,
658                        "query_count_in_community": query_count,
659                        "node_type": G.nodes[node].get("node_type", "unknown"),
660                    }
661                )
662
663        edge_rows = []
664        for u, v, data in G.edges(data=True):
665            u_s = str(u)
666            v_s = str(v)
667            edge_rows.append(
668                {
669                    "id1": u_s,
670                    "id2": v_s,
671                    "score": float(data.get("score", 0.0)),
672                    "cluster_id_1": node_to_cluster.get(u_s),
673                    "cluster_id_2": node_to_cluster.get(v_s),
674                    "intra_cluster": node_to_cluster.get(u_s)
675                    == node_to_cluster.get(v_s),
676                }
677            )
678
679        layout_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["node_id", "x", "y"])
680        if compute_layout and G.number_of_nodes() > 0:
681            layout = self._compute_hierarchical_layout(
682                G,
683                communities,
684                weight_attr=cluster_weight_attr,
685                seed=layout_seed,
686            )
687            layout_df = pd.DataFrame(
688                [
689                    {"node_id": str(node_id), "x": coords["x"], "y": coords["y"]}
690                    for node_id, coords in layout.items()
691                ]
692            )
693
694        artifact = {
695            "metric": metric,
696            "params": {
697                "include_queries_only": include_queries_only,
698                "score_threshold": score_threshold,
699                "max_edges": max_edges,
700                "max_nodes": max_nodes,
701                "exclude_self": exclude_self,
702                "directed": directed,
703                "drop_components_without_queries": drop_components_without_queries,
704                "drop_nodes_without_query_connection": drop_nodes_without_query_connection,
705                "cluster_method": cluster_method,
706                "cluster_weight_attr": cluster_weight_attr,
707                "cluster_super_threshold": cluster_super_threshold,
708                "cluster_sparsify_top_k": cluster_sparsify_top_k,
709                "cluster_recursive_split": cluster_recursive_split,
710                "cluster_min_size": cluster_min_size,
711                "compute_layout": compute_layout,
712                "layout_seed": layout_seed,
713            },
714            "node_table": pd.DataFrame(node_rows),
715            "community_table": pd.DataFrame(community_rows),
716            "edge_table": pd.DataFrame(edge_rows),
717            "layout_table": layout_df,
718            "schema_version": 1,
719        }
720
721        self._ensure_cluster_cache()[metric] = artifact
722
723        return {
724            "metric": metric,
725            "n_nodes": G.number_of_nodes(),
726            "n_edges": G.number_of_edges(),
727            "n_clusters": int(artifact["community_table"].shape[0]),
728            "score_threshold": float(score_threshold),
729        }

Compute and cache clustering artifacts for one similarity metric.

This stage is separate from plotting. It builds a graph from the selected similarity matrix, applies query-connectivity filters, computes communities, and stores node/community/edge/layout tables in an in-memory artifact cache for later plotting or export.

Parameters
  • metric (str): Similarity metric key from self.similarity_matrices.
  • include_queries_only (bool): Use query-focused edge filtering during edge extraction.
  • score_threshold (float or None): Minimum similarity score to include; None uses _threshold_for(metric).
  • max_edges (int or None): Keep top-N edges by score after filtering.
  • max_nodes (int or None): Keep edges whose endpoints are within highest-degree N nodes.
  • exclude_self (bool): Drop self-loop edges.
  • directed (bool): Build directed graph when True.
  • drop_components_without_queries (bool): Remove connected components with no query nodes.
  • drop_nodes_without_query_connection (bool): Keep only query nodes and one-hop query neighbors.
  • cluster_method (str): Community method; currently "weighted_greedy_modularity".
  • cluster_weight_attr (str): Edge attribute used as clustering weight.
  • cluster_super_threshold (int): Threshold above which recursive splitting can apply.
  • cluster_sparsify_top_k (int): Top-k edge sparsification for oversized community refinement.
  • cluster_recursive_split (bool): Enable recursive refinement of oversized communities.
  • cluster_min_size (int): Reserved for future use; kept for API stability.
  • compute_layout (bool): Compute and cache hierarchical node coordinates.
  • layout_seed (int): Random seed for deterministic layout generation.
Returns
  • dict: Summary with metric, n_nodes, n_edges, n_clusters, and score_threshold.
Raises
  • KeyError: If metric is unknown.
  • ValueError: If cluster_method is unsupported.

def save_network_clusters( self, output_dir: str, metric: str, run_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, str]: 
746    def save_network_clusters(
747        self, output_dir: str, metric: str, run_id: str | None = None
748    ) -> dict[str, str]:
749        """Persist computed cluster artifacts to CSV files.
750
751        Files written include node, community, edge, layout, and manifest CSVs.
752        Library node IDs are exported using stable identifiers when available
753        (for example ``spectra_id``) instead of internal index IDs.
754
755        Parameters
756        ----------
757        output_dir : str
758            Output directory for CSV artifacts.
759        metric : str
760            Metric cache key to persist.
761        run_id : str or None
762            Optional suffix to disambiguate multiple runs.
763
764        Returns
765        -------
766        dict of str to str
767            Paths for ``nodes``, ``communities``, ``edges``, ``layout``,
768            and ``manifest`` files.
769
770        Raises
771        ------
772        RuntimeError
773            If no cached clusters exist for *metric*.
774        """
775        cache = self._ensure_cluster_cache()
776        artifact = cache.get(metric)
777        if artifact is None:
778            raise RuntimeError(
779                f"No clusters available for metric '{metric}'. Call compute_network_clusters(...) first."
780            )
781
782        out_dir = Path(output_dir)
783        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
784
785        suffix = f"_{run_id}" if run_id else ""
786        prefix = f"{metric}_clusters{suffix}"
787
788        node_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_nodes.csv"
789        community_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_communities.csv"
790        edge_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_edges.csv"
791        manifest_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_manifest.csv"
792        layout_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_layout.csv"
793
794        query_id_set = set(getattr(self, "_all_query_ids", []) or [])
795
796        node_export_df = artifact["node_table"].copy()
797        if "node_id" in node_export_df.columns:
798            node_export_df["node_id"] = (
799                node_export_df["node_id"]
800                .astype(str)
801                .map(
802                    lambda node_id: self._export_cluster_node_id(node_id, query_id_set)
803                )
804            )
805
806        edge_export_df = artifact["edge_table"].copy()
807        if "id1" in edge_export_df.columns:
808            edge_export_df["id1"] = (
809                edge_export_df["id1"]
810                .astype(str)
811                .map(
812                    lambda node_id: self._export_cluster_node_id(node_id, query_id_set)
813                )
814            )
815        if "id2" in edge_export_df.columns:
816            edge_export_df["id2"] = (
817                edge_export_df["id2"]
818                .astype(str)
819                .map(
820                    lambda node_id: self._export_cluster_node_id(node_id, query_id_set)
821                )
822            )
823
824        layout_export_df = artifact["layout_table"].copy()
825        if "node_id" in layout_export_df.columns:
826            layout_export_df["node_id"] = (
827                layout_export_df["node_id"]
828                .astype(str)
829                .map(
830                    lambda node_id: self._export_cluster_node_id(node_id, query_id_set)
831                )
832            )
833
834        node_export_df.to_csv(node_path, index=False)
835        artifact["community_table"].to_csv(community_path, index=False)
836        edge_export_df.to_csv(edge_path, index=False)
837        layout_export_df.to_csv(layout_path, index=False)
838
839        pd.DataFrame(
840            [
841                {
842                    "schema_version": artifact.get("schema_version", 1),
843                    "metric": metric,
844                    "run_id": run_id or "",
845                    "params_json": json.dumps(
846                        artifact.get("params", {}), sort_keys=True
847                    ),
848                }
849            ]
850        ).to_csv(manifest_path, index=False)
851
852        return {
853            "nodes": str(node_path),
854            "communities": str(community_path),
855            "edges": str(edge_path),
856            "layout": str(layout_path),
857            "manifest": str(manifest_path),
858        }

Files written include node, community, edge, layout, and manifest CSVs. Library node IDs are exported using stable identifiers when available (for example spectra_id) instead of internal index IDs.

Parameters

860    def load_network_clusters(
861        self, output_dir: str, metric: str, run_id: str | None = None
862    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
863        """Load cluster artifacts from CSV files into in-memory cache.
864
865        Parameters
866        ----------
867        output_dir : str
868            Directory containing saved cluster CSV artifacts.
869        metric : str
870            Metric key to load.
871        run_id : str or None
872            Optional run suffix used when saving.
873
874        Returns
875        -------
876        dict
877            Summary with ``metric``, ``n_nodes``, ``n_edges``, and
878            ``n_clusters``.
879
880        Raises
881        ------
882        FileNotFoundError
883            If required artifact files are missing.
884        """
885        out_dir = Path(output_dir)
886        suffix = f"_{run_id}" if run_id else ""
887        prefix = f"{metric}_clusters{suffix}"
888
889        node_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_nodes.csv"
890        community_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_communities.csv"
891        edge_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_edges.csv"
892        manifest_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_manifest.csv"
893        layout_path = out_dir / f"{prefix}_layout.csv"
894
895        if (
896            not node_path.exists()
897            or not community_path.exists()
898            or not edge_path.exists()
899        ):
900            raise FileNotFoundError(
901                f"Missing cluster artifact files for metric '{metric}' in '{output_dir}'."
902            )
903
904        params = {}
905        schema_version = 1
906        if manifest_path.exists():
907            mdf = pd.read_csv(manifest_path)
908            if not mdf.empty:
909                schema_version = int(mdf.iloc[0].get("schema_version", 1))
910                params_json = mdf.iloc[0].get("params_json", "{}")
911                try:
912                    params = (
913                        json.loads(params_json) if isinstance(params_json, str) else {}
914                    )
915                except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError):
916                    params = {}
917
918        artifact = {
919            "metric": metric,
920            "params": params,
921            "schema_version": schema_version,
922            "node_table": pd.read_csv(node_path),
923            "community_table": pd.read_csv(community_path),
924            "edge_table": pd.read_csv(edge_path),
925            "layout_table": pd.read_csv(layout_path)
926            if layout_path.exists()
927            else pd.DataFrame(columns=["node_id", "x", "y"]),
928        }
929
930        self._ensure_cluster_cache()[metric] = artifact
931        return {
932            "metric": metric,
933            "n_nodes": int(artifact["node_table"].shape[0]),
934            "n_edges": int(artifact["edge_table"].shape[0]),
935            "n_clusters": int(artifact["community_table"].shape[0]),
936        }

1192        For interactive HTML exploration, use :meth:`plot_interactive_network`
1193        (requires ``ipysigma`` / ``corems[networking]``).
1194
1195        Parameters
1196        ----------

1198            Similarity metric key. Default ``"entropy_similarity"``.
1199        ax : matplotlib.axes.Axes, optional
