1214        label_max_nodes : int
1215            Maximum number of labels to draw (highest-degree nodes). Default 40.
1216        node_size_query, node_size_library : float
1217            Matplotlib scatter sizes for query vs library nodes.

1219            Figure size when *ax* is None. Default ``(9, 7)``.

1221            Axes title. Default summarizes metric, threshold, and edge count.

1226        -------
1227        matplotlib.figure.Figure or None
1228            The figure if *return_fig* is True, otherwise None.
1229        """
1230        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
1231        from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
1232
1233        G, layout, palette, thr = self._build_networkx_graph(
1234            metric=metric,
1235            include_queries_only=include_queries_only,
1236            score_threshold=score_threshold,
1237            max_edges=max_edges,
1238            max_nodes=max_nodes,
1239            exclude_self=exclude_self,
1240            directed=False,
1241            color_map=color_map,
1242            library_label_field=library_label_field,
1243            drop_components_without_queries=drop_components_without_queries,
1244            drop_nodes_without_query_connection=drop_nodes_without_query_connection,
1245            layout_seed=layout_seed,
1246            bypass_clustering=bypass_clustering,
1247            separate_communities=separate_communities,
1248        )
1249
1250        if ax is None:
1251            fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
1252        else:
1253            fig = ax.figure
1254
1255        if layout is None or G.number_of_nodes() == 0:
1256            ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No network edges to plot", ha="center", va="center")
1257            ax.set_axis_off()
1258        else:
1259            pos = {
1260                n: (float(layout[str(n)]["x"]), float(layout[str(n)]["y"]))
1261                for n in G.nodes
1262                if str(n) in layout
1263            }
1264            # Fallback positions for any missing layout keys
1265            for n in G.nodes:
1266                if n not in pos:
1267                    pos[n] = (0.0, 0.0)
1268
1269            scores = [float(d.get("score", 0.0)) for _, _, d in G.edges(data=True)]
1270            smin = min(scores) if scores else 0.0
1271            smax = max(scores) if scores else 1.0
1272            span = (smax - smin) + 1e-12
1273
1274            for u, v, data in G.edges(data=True):
1275                x0, y0 = pos[u]
1276                x1, y1 = pos[v]
1277                score = float(data.get("score", 0.0))
1278                lw = 0.5 + 2.5 * ((score - smin) / span)
1279                ax.plot([x0, x1], [y0, y1], color="0.65", lw=lw, zorder=1, alpha=0.85)
1280
1281            for n, (x, y) in pos.items():
1282                is_query = G.nodes[n].get("node_type") == "query"
1283                ax.scatter(
1284                    [x],
1285                    [y],
1286                    s=node_size_query if is_query else node_size_library,
1287                    c=palette.get("query" if is_query else "library", "#95a5a6"),
1288                    edgecolors="white",
1289                    linewidths=0.6,
1290                    zorder=2,
1291                )
1292
1293            if show_labels and G.number_of_nodes() > 0:
1294                degrees = dict(G.degree())
1295                label_nodes = sorted(degrees, key=lambda n: (-degrees[n], str(n)))[
1296                    : max(0, int(label_max_nodes))
1297                ]
1298                for n in label_nodes:
1299                    x, y = pos[n]
1300                    label = str(G.nodes[n].get("label", n))
1301                    if len(label) > 18:
1302                        label = label[:15] + "…"
1303                    ax.text(x, y, label, fontsize=7, ha="center", va="bottom", zorder=3)
1304
1305            legend = [
1306                Line2D(
1307                    [0],
1308                    [0],
1309                    marker="o",
1310                    color="w",
1311                    markerfacecolor=palette.get("query", "#e74c3c"),
1312                    markersize=9,
1313                    label="Experimental MS2 (query)",
1314                ),
1315                Line2D(
1316                    [0],
1317                    [0],
1318                    marker="o",
1319                    color="w",
1320                    markerfacecolor=palette.get("library", "#3498db"),
1321                    markersize=8,
1322                    label="Library spectrum",
1323                ),
1324            ]
1325            ax.legend(handles=legend, loc="best", frameon=True)
1326            ax.set_axis_off()
1327
1328        if title is None:
1329            title = (
1330                f"Molecular network ({metric}, threshold={thr:g}, "
1331                f"{G.number_of_edges()} edges)"
1332            )
1333        ax.set_title(title)
1334        fig.tight_layout()
1335
1336        if path is not None:
1337            fig.savefig(path, dpi=dpi, bbox_inches="tight")
1338
1339        if return_fig:
1340            return fig
1341
1342        # Prefer IPython Image display so notebooks capture PNG under Agg / headless CI
1343        try:
1344            import io
1345
1346            from IPython import get_ipython
1347            from IPython.display import Image, display
1348
1349            if get_ipython() is not None:
1350                buf = io.BytesIO()
1351                fig.savefig(buf, format="png", dpi=dpi, bbox_inches="tight")
1352                display(Image(data=buf.getvalue()))
1353                plt.close(fig)
1354                return None
1355        except ImportError:
1356            pass
1357
1358        plt.show()
1359        return None

Draw a static matplotlib snapshot of the molecular network.

Portable for Jupyter notebooks rendered on GitLab/GitHub (PNG output). For interactive HTML exploration, use plot_interactive_network() (requires ipysigma / corems[networking]).

Parameters
  • metric (str): Similarity metric key. Default "entropy_similarity".
  • ax (matplotlib.axes.Axes, optional): Axes to draw on. If None, a new figure is created.
  • path (str, optional): If set, save the figure to this path (savefig).
  • return_fig (bool): If True, return the Figure and do not call plt.show(). Default False.
  • include_queries_only, score_threshold, max_edges, max_nodes, …: Edge/node filtering and layout options (see plot_interactive_network()).
  • bypass_clustering (bool): If True (default), plot the raw filtered graph without requiring precomputed clusters.
  • show_labels (bool): Draw node labels (capped by label_max_nodes). Default True.
  • label_max_nodes (int): Maximum number of labels to draw (highest-degree nodes). Default 40.
  • node_size_query, node_size_library (float): Matplotlib scatter sizes for query vs library nodes.
  • figsize (tuple of float): Figure size when ax is None. Default (9, 7).
  • title (str, optional): Axes title. Default summarizes metric, threshold, and edge count.
  • dpi (int): DPI used when saving path. Default 150.
Returns
  • matplotlib.figure.Figure or None: The figure if return_fig is True, otherwise None.

Write an interactive ipysigma HTML network visualization.

Prefer plot_network() for static snapshots that render on GitLab/GitHub notebook previews. This method requires ipysigma (pip install "corems[networking]").

Parameters
  • out_path (str): Output HTML file path.
  • separate_communities (bool): When plotting from precomputed clusters (bypass_clustering=False), remove inter-community edges so each community renders as a separate subnetwork. Default True.
  • display_in_notebook (bool): If True, also embed the HTML in a local Jupyter frontend via a data-URI iframe. Does not render on GitLab/GitHub notebook previews. Default False.
  • iframe_height (int): Pixel height of the notebook iframe when display_in_notebook is True. Default 650.
Returns
  • str: Path to the written HTML file.
